title.zh: 卷十三 本紀第十三: 德宗下
title.raw: 卷十三 本紀第十三: 德宗下 Volume 13 Annals 13: Dezong 2

sentences.zh: 德宗下貞元四年春正月庚戌朔，上御丹鳳樓，制曰：「朕以菲薄，托於王公之上，恭承天地之序，虔奉祖宗之訓，遐想至理，思臻大和。

translations.literal: Dezong 2 — On the first day of the first month of Zhenyuan 4, gengxu new moon, the Emperor ascended Danfeng Tower and decreed: "I am of slight virtue, enthroned above kings and dukes, reverently inheriting Heaven-and-earth's order and devoutly observing the ancestors' teachings, pondering remote supreme principle, thinking to attain great harmony."
translations.idiomatic: Dezong 2 — First month, Zhenyuan 4, gengxu new moon: the Emperor took Danfeng Tower and issued an edict lamenting his thin merit yet heavy throne, his wish for universal harmony.

sentences.zh: 而誠不感物，化不柔遠，聲教猶鬱，征賦仍繁。

translations.literal: Yet sincerity had not moved things; transformation had not softened the distant; civilizing instruction still stifled; levies remained heavy.
translations.idiomatic: His sincerity had not touched the realm; taxes and distant peoples alike still suffered.

sentences.zh: 頃者務於安人，不憚屈己，與西蕃結好，申以齊盟。

translations.literal: Recently, striving to settle the people, he had not feared humbling himself, concluding friendship with the Western Tibetans and pledging alliance.
translations.idiomatic: He had lately humbled himself to make peace with Tibet.

sentences.zh: 而戎心不厭，背義虧信，劫脅士庶，屢犯封疆，元元何辜，皆朕之失。

translations.literal: Yet the barbarians' hearts were insatiable; they betrayed faith and injured trust, seized officials and commoners, and repeatedly violated the borders — what guilt had the masses? All was the Emperor's fault.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet broke faith, raided the frontier, and seized subjects — blame he laid on himself alone.

sentences.zh: 乃者輦轂之下，兇狂結構，上帝垂祐，悉自伏誅，刑以止殺，諒非獲已。

translations.literal: Then beneath the imperial carriage violent men had plotted; Heaven's grace had aided, and all were executed of themselves; punishment to stop killing — surely not undertaken willingly.
translations.idiomatic: Recent sedition at the capital had been crushed; executions, he said, were a grim necessity.

sentences.zh: 今三陽布和，萬物資始，思與群公兆庶，惟新政理，宜敷在宥之澤，以覃作解之恩。

translations.literal: Now the three yangs spread harmony and the myriad things begin — he wished with dukes and ministers and the myriad people to renew governance; it was fitting to spread pardoning grace and extend the merit of releasing bonds.
translations.idiomatic: With spring's return he sought a new start and a broad amnesty.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下，大闢已下罪咸赦除之。

translations.literal: A great amnesty of the empire was permitted; crimes down to great execution were all pardoned and removed.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered a general amnesty through capital crimes.

sentences.zh: 」是日質明，含元殿前階基欄檻壞損三十餘間，壓死衛士十餘人。

translations.literal: That day at dawn the balustrades of the steps before Hanyuan Hall were damaged in more than thirty bays; more than ten guards were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the Hanyuan steps collapsed, killing a dozen guards.

sentences.zh: 京師地震，辛亥又震，壬子又震。

translations.literal: The capital quaked; on xinhai it quaked again; on renzi again.
translations.idiomatic: Chang'an shook; quakes followed on xinhai and renzi.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以左龍武大將軍王棲曜為麟州刺史、鄜州刺史、鄜坊丹延節度使。

translations.literal: On renxu Left Dragon Martial Grand General Wang Qiyao was made Lin prefect, Bin prefect, and commissioner of Bin, Fang, Dan, and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Wang Qiyao became commissioner of Bin-Fang-Dan-Yan.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，京師地震，戊辰又震，庚午又震。

translations.literal: On dingmao the capital quaked; on wuchen again; on gengwu again.
translations.idiomatic: Earthquakes struck the capital on dingmao, wuchen, and gengwu.

sentences.zh: 以宣武軍行營節度使劉昌為涇州刺史、四鎮北庭行軍涇原等州節度使。

translations.literal: Xuanwu circuit field commissioner Liu Chang was made Jing prefect and commissioner of the Four Garrisons, Northern Court field army, Jingyuan, and related prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chang left Xuanwu for Jingyuan command.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，京師地震。

translations.literal: On guiyou the capital quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou another capital quake.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以華州潼關節度使李元諒兼隴右節度使、臨洮軍使。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Hua prefecture Tong Pass commissioner Li Yuanliang was made concurrent Longyou commissioner and Lintao army commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Yuanliang added Longyou and Lintao.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，地震，金、房尤甚，江溢山裂，廬舍多壞，居人露處。

translations.literal: On yihai there was an earthquake; Jin and Fang were worst; rivers overflowed and mountains split; many dwellings were ruined; people camped in the open.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai a severe quake wrecked houses from Jin to Fang; refugees slept outdoors.

sentences.zh: 陳留雨木如大指，長寸餘，有孔通中，下而植於地，凡十里許。

translations.literal: At Chenliu wood rained like a large finger, more than an inch long, with holes through the center, falling and planting in the ground — in all about ten li.
translations.idiomatic: Chenliu saw stick-like rain-wood pierce the ground for ten li.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，李泌以京官俸薄，請取中外給用除陌錢，及闕官俸外一分職田、額內官俸，及刺史執刀司馬軍事等錢，令戶部別庫貯之，以給京官月俸，令御史中丞竇參專掌之。

translations.literal: On xinsi Li Mi, finding capital officials' salaries thin, requested taking the chumo money from internal and external disbursements, one-tenth of vacant-office salary, quota inner-office salary, and prefectural saber-bearers' and staff salaries, stored in a separate Treasury vault for capital monthly pay, with Vice Censor-in-Chief Dou Can in charge.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Mi funded capital salaries from miscellaneous fees, with Dou Can as custodian.

sentences.zh: 歲得錢三百萬貫，謂之戶部別處錢，朝臣歲支不過五十萬，常有二百餘萬以資國用。

translations.literal: The year yielded three million strings, called the Treasury Separate Reserve; court salaries did not exceed five hundred thousand, and more than two million regularly supplied state use.
translations.idiomatic: The fund brought three million strings yearly; two million surplus remained for the state.

sentences.zh: 壬午，地震，甲申又震，乙酉又震，丙申又震。

translations.literal: On renwu there was an earthquake; on jiashen again; on yiyou again; on bingchen again.
translations.idiomatic: Quakes recurred on renwu, jiashen, yiyou, and bingchen.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太僕郊牛生犢六足，又豕生兩首四足。

translations.literal: On jiachen the suburban ox of the Grand Stud bore a six-footed calf; a pig also bore two heads and four feet.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen a six-legged calf and a two-headed pig were born.

sentences.zh: 築延喜門北復道屬永春門。

translations.literal: The elevated passage north of Yanxi Gate was built to reach Yongchun Gate.
translations.idiomatic: A covered walk linked Yanxi and Yongchun gates.

sentences.zh: 涇原劉昌復築連雲堡。

translations.literal: Jingyuan's Liu Chang rebuilt Lianyun Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chang restored Lianyun Fort on the Jing frontier.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，鹿入京師市門。

translations.literal: On wuchen a deer entered a capital market gate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen a deer wandered into the city markets.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，地震。

translations.literal: On jiayin there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 宴群臣於麟德殿，設《九部樂》，內出舞馬，上賦詩一章，群臣屬和。

translations.literal: He feasted the ministers at Linde Hall, set the Nine Sections music, and palace dancing horses were brought out; the Emperor composed one stanza and the ministers matched it.
translations.idiomatic: At Linde he banqueted the court with Nine Sections music and dancing horses, trading poems with his ministers.

sentences.zh: 己未，地震。

translations.literal: On jiwei there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei another quake.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，有司條奏省官，其左右常侍、太子賓客請依前置四員，從之。

translations.literal: The relevant office memorialized reducing offices; for Left and Right Regular Attendants and Crown Prince Guests they asked to restore the former four posts each — approved.
translations.idiomatic: Regular Attendants and Crown Prince Guests were restored to four posts each.

sentences.zh: 庚午，地震。

translations.literal: On gengwu there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the capital shook again.

sentences.zh: 詔涇原劉昌於平涼會盟所收被害將士骸骨，葬於淺水原，為二塚，立石堠志之，題曰懷忠塚。

translations.literal: An edict: Jingyuan's Liu Chang should bury at Qianshui Plain the bones of officers and soldiers killed at the Pingliang parley site in two mounds, erect stone markers, and inscribe them "Mounds of Cherished Loyalty."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chang was ordered to bury Pingliang's dead at Qianshui in the "Mounds of Cherished Loyalty."

sentences.zh: 辛未，地震。

translations.literal: On xinwei there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei another earthquake.

sentences.zh: 中書省梧樹有鵲以泥為巢。

translations.literal: At the Secretariat a parasol tree had magpies building a nest with mud.
translations.idiomatic: Magpies nested in mud on a parasol tree at the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以太子左庶子暢悅為桂管觀察使。

translations.literal: On guisi Crown Prince Left Senior Mentor Chang Yue was made Guilin circuit observer.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Chang Yue became Guilin observer.

sentences.zh: 改左右射生為左右神威軍。

translations.literal: Left and Right Archer-Guards were renamed Left and Right Divine Awe Armies.
translations.idiomatic: The Archer-Guards were retitled the Divine Awe Armies.

sentences.zh: 福建兵亂，逐觀察使吳詵。

translations.literal: Fujian troops mutinied and expelled observer Wu Shen.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian soldiers drove out observer Wu Shen.

sentences.zh: 丁未，隴右李元諒築良原城。

translations.literal: On dingwei Longyou's Li Yuanliang built Liangyuan city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Li Yuanliang built Liangyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，右龍武統軍張伯儀卒。

translations.literal: On dingsi Right Dragon Martial commander-in-chief Zhang Boyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Zhang Boyi died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以吉州刺史張庭為安南都護、本管經略使。

translations.literal: On xinyou Ji prefect Zhang Ting was made Protector-General of Annan and circuit commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Zhang Ting took Annan.

sentences.zh: 升鄆州為大都督府。

translations.literal: Yan prefecture was promoted to a great metropolitan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou became a metropolitan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，加置諫議大夫八員，分中書四員為右，門下四員為左。

translations.literal: On renxu eight Remonstrating Censors were added — four of the Secretariat as Right, four of the Chancellery as Left.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu eight censor posts were added, split between Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 檢校左庶子蕭復卒於饒州。

translations.literal: Acting Left Senior Mentor Xiao Fu died at Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Fu died in exile at Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，地震，丁卯，又震。

translations.literal: On bingyin there was an earthquake; on dingmao again.
translations.idiomatic: Earthquakes on bingyin and dingmao.

sentences.zh: 月犯歲星。

translations.literal: The moon infringed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: The moon crossed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太子賓客吳湊為福建觀察使。

translations.literal: On xinwei Crown Prince Guest Wu Cou was made Fujian observer.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Wu Cou became Fujian observer.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，熒惑、歲、鎮三星聚營室，凡二十日。

translations.literal: On yihai Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn gathered in Yingshi — in all twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: For twenty days Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn stood in Yingshi.

sentences.zh: 是月，吐蕃寇涇、邠、寧、慶、鄜等州，焚彭原縣，邊將閉城自固。

translations.literal: That month Tibet raided Jing, Bin, Ning, Qing, and Bin prefectures, burned Pengyuan county, and frontier generals shut their cities to hold fast.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet raided the northwest, burning Pengyuan while garrisons closed their walls.

sentences.zh: 賊驅人畜三萬計，凡二旬而退。

translations.literal: The bandits drove off more than thirty thousand head of men and beasts; after about twenty days they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: They carried off thirty thousand people and animals, then withdrew after twenty days.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃入寇以秋冬，今盛暑而來，華人陷蕃者道之也。

translations.literal: Tibetan raids usually came in autumn and winter; now they came in great heat — Chinese who had fallen to Tibet guided them.
translations.idiomatic: A midsummer raid showed defectors were guiding Tibet.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，鄂岳觀察使李竦卒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingchou: E-Yue observer Li Song died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Li Song of E-Yue died.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以尚書左丞杜祐為陜州長史、陜虢觀察使。

translations.literal: On yiyou Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat Du You was made Shaan prefect and Shaan-Guo observer.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Du You became Shaan-Guo commissioner.

sentences.zh: 征夏縣處士先除著作郎陽城為諫議大夫。

translations.literal: The recluse of Xia county, first appointed Drafting Editor Yang Cheng, was summoned as Remonstrating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Cheng, a Xia recluse lately made editor, was called to the censorate.

sentences.zh: 城以褐衣詣闕，上賜之章服而後召。

translations.literal: Cheng came to the palace in brown clothes; the Emperor bestowed court robes and then summoned him.
translations.idiomatic: He arrived in homespun; the throne gave him robes before audience.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，桂管都防禦觀察使暢悅卒。

translations.literal: On yichou Guilin defense-and-observation commissioner Chang Yue died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Chang Yue died in Guilin.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以諫議大夫何士干為鄂、岳、沔、蘄、黃等州都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On yiwei Remonstrating Censor He Shigan was made united training-and-observation commissioner of E, Yue, Mian, Qi, and Huang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei He Shigan took E-Yue and neighboring circuits.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，封皇子、皇弟邕王謜等七人為王，兼卿、監、祭酒等官。

translations.literal: On yihai imperial sons and younger imperial brothers — seven including Prince of Yong, Zhen — were enfeoffed princes, with concurrent minister, supervisor, and libationer posts.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai seven princes and imperial brothers received titles and concurrent court posts.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，熒惑退行入羽林。

translations.literal: On guimao Mars moved retrograde into the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Mars retrograded into the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，以左金吾將軍張獻甫為邠寧節度使；

translations.literal: Seventh month, gengxu: Left Golden Guards general Zhang Xianfu was made Binning commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengxu: Zhang Xianfu took Binning;

sentences.zh: 陳許防禦兵馬使韓全義檢校工部尚書，充長武城及諸軍行營節度使。

translations.literal: Chen-Xu defense army commander Han Quanyi was made acting Minister of Works and commissioner of the Changwu city and related field armies.
translations.idiomatic: Han Quanyi became acting Works minister and Changwu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，邠寧軍因韓游瑰受代，憚張獻甫之嚴，乘其無帥，縱兵大掠，仍脅監軍楊明義奏請範希朝為帥。

translations.literal: On guichou the Binning army, because Han Yougui was replaced, feared Zhang Xianfu's severity; while leaderless they plundered greatly and coerced Army Supervisor Yang Mingyi to memorialize for Fan Xichao as commander.
translations.idiomatic: Binning troops rioted when Yougui left, demanding Fan Xichao over the stern Xianfu.

sentences.zh: 都虞候楊朝晟斬其亂首二百餘人，方定。

translations.literal: Chief commandant Yang Chaocheng beheaded more than two hundred ringleaders before order was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Chaocheng killed two hundred mutineers to restore order.

sentences.zh: 朝命仍以希朝副獻甫。

translations.literal: The court still ordered Xichao as Xianfu's deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The court made Xichao Xianfu's deputy.

sentences.zh: 己未，奚、室韋寇振武軍。

translations.literal: On jiwei the Xi and Shiwei raided Zhenwu army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Xi and Shiwei hit Zhenwu.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔以太尉、中書令、西平郡王李晟長子願為銀青光錄大夫、太子賓客，賜勛上柱國，與晟門並列戟。

translations.literal: On renxu an edict: Grand Preceptor, Secretariat Director, Prince of Xiping Li Sheng's eldest son Yuan was made Silver-Green Glory Grandee, Crown Prince Guest, with superior merit pillar of state, and halberds at Sheng's gate like the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Sheng's son Yuan received high rank and gate halberds.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以前撫州刺史戴叔倫為容州刺史、兼御史中丞、本管經略使。

translations.literal: On yichou former Fu prefect Dai Shulun was made Rong prefect, concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, and circuit commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Dai Shulun took Rong with a censor's seal.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以兵部尚書崔漢衡為晉州刺史、晉慈隰觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingchou Minister of War Cui Hanheng was made Jin prefect and Jin-Ci-Long observer.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Cui Hanheng became Jin-Ci-Long commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔：「嗣王、郡王朝會，班位在本官班之上。

translations.literal: On renshen an edict: "At court assemblies, enfeoffed kings and commandery princes shall rank above their substantive offices.
translations.idiomatic: An edict raised enfeoffed princes above their substantive ranks at court.

sentences.zh: 左右庶子準令在左右丞侍郎之下、諸司四品之上，今在少卿之下，非也，宜改之。

translations.literal: Left and Right Senior Mentors by statute should stand below Left and Right Vice Directors and Vice Ministers and above all fourth-rank offices; now they are below Junior Ministers — this is wrong and should be changed."
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict; Senior Mentors were restored above fourth rank and below vice ministers.

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，以蘇州刺史孫晟為桂州刺史、桂管觀察使。

translations.literal: On yihai Suzhou prefect Sun Sheng was made Guilin prefect and Guilin observer.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Sun Sheng took Guilin.

sentences.zh: 荊河自陜州至河陰，水色如墨，流入汴口，至汴州，一宿而復。

translations.literal: From Shaan to Heyin the Jing and Yellow rivers' water was like ink; it entered the Bian mouth; at Bian prefecture it returned normal after one night.
translations.idiomatic: The Jing-Huang reach ran black as ink to Bianzhou, then cleared overnight.

sentences.zh: 又汴鄭管內烏皆入田緒、李納之境，銜柴為城，方十餘里，高二三尺，緒、納惡而去之，信宿復如之，烏口皆流血。

translations.literal: Again within Bian and Zheng circuits crows all entered Tian Xu and Li Na's territory, carrying brushwood as walls about ten li square and two or three chi high; Xu and Na hated it and drove them off, yet after one or two nights it was as before — the crows' mouths all bled.
translations.idiomatic: Crows in Bian-Zheng built brush ramparts in Tian Xu and Li Na's lands until driven off, bleeding from their beaks.

sentences.zh: 八月，以權判吏部侍郎吉中孚為中書舍人。

translations.literal: Eighth month: acting Judge of the Secretariat Ji Zhongfu was made Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Ji Zhongfu became a drafter.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，檢校司徒、兼太子太師、汧國公李勉薨。

translations.literal: On yiyou Acting Grand Mentor, concurrent Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Prince of Qian, Li Mian died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Li Mian died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，京師地震，其聲如雷。

translations.literal: On jiawu the capital quaked; the sound was like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu a thunderous earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，詔：「比者卿士內外，左右朕躬，朝夕公門，勤勞庶務。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingwu, edict: "Recently ministers inside and outside have attended my person, morning and evening at the public gates, laboring at the myriad affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingwu: an edict praised ministers' daily labor at court.

sentences.zh: 今方隅無事，烝庶小康，其正月晦日、三月三日、九月九日三節日，宜任文武百僚選勝地追賞為樂。

translations.literal: Now the regions are without incident and the masses somewhat at ease; on the three festivals — last day of the first month, third day of the third month, and ninth day of the ninth month — civil and military officials may choose scenic places for pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: With peace returning, the three spring-and-autumn festivals were made holidays for scenic outings.

sentences.zh: 每節宰相及常參官共賜錢五百貫文，翰林學士一百貫文，左右神威、神策等軍每廂共賜錢五百貫文，金吾、英武、威遠諸衛將軍共賜錢二百貫文，客省奏事共賜錢一百貫文，委度支每節前五日支付，永為常式。

translations.literal: Each festival the chancellors and regular attendees together received five hundred strings; Hanlin academicians one hundred strings; each file of Left and Right Divine Awe and Divine Strategy armies five hundred strings; Golden Guards, Heroic Martial, and Prestigious Far guards' generals two hundred strings; the Guest Bureau for memorials one hundred strings — Revenue to pay five days before each festival, permanently as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Festival cash gifts to chancellors, Hanlin, guards, and the Guest Bureau were fixed by Revenue.

sentences.zh: 」戊申，晉慈隰觀察使崔漢衡加都防禦使名。

translations.literal: On wushen Jin-Ci-Long observer Cui Hanheng added the title of overall defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Cui Hanheng gained an overall defense title.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賜百僚宴於曲江亭，仍作《重陽賜宴詩》六韻賜之。

translations.literal: On guichou the hundred officials were feasted at Qujiang Pavilion; the Emperor also composed a six-rhyme "Chongyang Banquet Poem" and bestowed it.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the court banqueted at Qujiang and received an imperial Chongyang poem.

sentences.zh: 群臣畢和，上品其優劣，以劉太真、李紓為上等，鮑防、於邵為次等，張濛、殷亮等二十人又次之。

translations.literal: The ministers all matched it; the best were ranked — Liu Taizhen and Li Shu as top, Bao Fang and Yu Shao next, Zhang Meng, Yin Liang, and twenty others after.
translations.idiomatic: Poem matches were graded; Liu Taizhen and Li Shu led, Bao Fang and Yu Shao next.

sentences.zh: 唯李晟、馬燧、李泌三宰相之詩不加優劣。

translations.literal: Only the three chancellors Li Sheng, Ma Sui, and Li Mi had no ranking of superiority or inferiority.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng, Ma Sui, and Li Mi were exempted from ranking.

sentences.zh: 庚申，吐蕃寇邠、寧、坊等州。

translations.literal: On gengshen Tibet raided Bin, Ning, and Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Tibetan forces struck Bin, Ning, and Fang circuits.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，詔中書門下選常參官曾為牧宰有理行者以名聞。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter: an edict ordered the Secretariat and Chancellery to select regular attendees who had been prefects and magistrates with good governance and report their names.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat was told to name former magistrates of proven merit.

sentences.zh: 宰臣奏於頎、董晉等十二人前任有治跡，詔頎等於左右丞聽各言政要，左右丞條奏，上乃御宣政殿親試其言而後用之。

translations.literal: The chancellors memorialized twelve including Yu Qi and Dong Jin whose prior posts had traces of good rule; an edict ordered Yu and the rest, with Left and Right Vice Directors listening, each to state policy essentials; the Vice Directors memorialized in items; the Emperor then personally tested their words at Xuanzheng Hall before employing them.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve proven administrators were examined at Xuanzheng before appointment.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以右神策將軍李長榮為河陽三城懷州團練使，仍賜名元。

translations.literal: On bingxu Right Divine Strategy general Li Changrong was made Heyang Three Cities Huai prefect training commissioner, and his name Yuan was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Changrong took Heyang and was renamed Yuan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，回紇公主將妾媵六十餘人、馬二千匹來迎咸安公主，命刑部尚書關播送公主歸蕃。

translations.literal: On wuzi the Uighur princess was to bring more than sixty concubines and maids and two thousand horses to welcome Princess Xian'an; Minister of Justice Guan Bo was ordered to escort the princess to the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Guan Bo escorted Princess Xian'an to Uighur betrothal with a vast train.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，少府監李觀卒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinsi: Court of the Imperial Regalia Director Li Guan died.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinsi: Li Guan died.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月壬辰朔。

translations.literal: Fifth year, first month, renchen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Year 5, first month, renchen new moon.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔：「四序嘉辰，歷代增置，漢崇上巳，晉紀重陽，或說禳除，雖因舊俗，與眾共樂，咸合當時。

translations.literal: On yimao an edict: "The four seasons' fine days — each age has added them; Han honored the upper si day, Jin marked Double Ninth — some spoke of averting ill, though following old custom, sharing joy with the masses suits the time.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao an edict reviewed festival lore from Han and Jin.

sentences.zh: 朕以春方發生，候及仲月，勾萌畢達，天地和同，俾其昭蘇，宜助暢茂。

translations.literal: I take the spring season of generation, when the second month arrives, all buds fully reach, Heaven and Earth in harmony — to aid renewal it is fitting to help luxuriant growth.
translations.idiomatic: Spring's second month, he said, should aid growth and renewal.

sentences.zh: 自今宜以二月一日為中和節，以代正月晦日，備三令節數，內外官司休假一日。

translations.literal: Henceforth the second month's first day shall be the Mid-Harmony Festival, replacing the first month's last day, completing the three statutory festivals; inner and outer offices rest one day."
translations.idiomatic: The second month's first day became the Mid-Harmony Festival with a day off for all offices.

sentences.zh: 」宰臣李泌請中和節日令百官進農書，司農獻穜稑之種，王公戚里上春服，士庶以刀尺相問遺，村社作中和酒，祭勾芒以祈年穀，從之。

translations.literal: Chancellor Li Mi requested that on Mid-Harmony officials present agricultural books, the Court of the Imperial Granaries offer seed grain, kings and consort kin present spring garments, commoners exchange measuring rods as gifts, villages brew Mid-Harmony wine, and sacrifice to Gou Mang for the year's grain — approved.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mi's Mid-Harmony rites — farm books, seed, spring dress, wine, and Gou Mang sacrifice — were adopted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，右散騎常侍宜城縣子柳渾卒。

translations.literal: On dingmao Right Regular Attendant, Viscount of Yicheng, Liu Hun died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Liu Hun died.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，貶京兆尹鄭叔則為永州長史。

translations.literal: Second month, jichou: Capital Intendant Zheng Shuzhe was demoted to Yongzhou senior administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jichou: Zheng Shuzhe lost the capital and went to Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以滄景留後程懷直為滄景觀察使。

translations.literal: On wuxu Cang-Jing acting commissioner Cheng Huaizhi was made Cang-Jing observer.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Cheng Huaizhi became full Cang-Jing observer.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以大理卿董晉為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事；

translations.literal: On gengzi Grand Court Judge Dong Jin was made Chancellery Vice Director and Associate Grand Secretariat Director;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Dong Jin entered the chancellery;

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞竇參為中書侍郎、平章事兼轉運使；

translations.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Dou Can was made Secretariat Vice Director, Associate Director, and concurrent transport commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Dou Can became vice director and transport commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書，依前度支轉運副使。

translations.literal: Ban Hong was made Minister of Revenue, continuing as before as revenue and transport vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ban Hong kept Revenue and his revenue-transport vice commission.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，中書侍郎、同平章事李泌卒。

translations.literal: Third month, jiachen: Secretariat Vice Director, Associate Director Li Mi died.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiachen: Li Mi died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以兵部郎中姚南仲為御史中丞，司農卿薛玨為京兆尹，以大理卿李速為黔州刺史、黔州觀察使。

translations.literal: On yimao War Department bureau director Yao Nanzhong was made Censor-in-Chief; Court of the Imperial Granaries Director Xue Jue was made Capital Intendant; Grand Court Judge Li Su was made Qian prefect and Qian observer.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Yao Nanzhong, Xue Jue, and Li Su took censorate, capital, and Qian posts.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以資州刺史龐復為安南都護、本管經略使。

translations.literal: On guihai Zi prefect Pang Fu was made Protector-General of Annan and circuit commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Pang Fu took Annan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，貶禮部侍郎劉太真為信州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingyin Minister of Rites Vice Director Liu Taizhen was demoted to Xin prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Liu Taizhen was demoted to Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 以給事中杜黃裳為河南尹。

translations.literal: The Drafting Attendant Du Huangshang was made Henan Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Du Huangshang became Henan Intendant.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔以李懷光外孫燕八八為左衛率府胄曹參軍，賜姓名曰李承緒，仍賜錢千貫，俾自營居業。

translations.literal: On wuchen an edict made Li Huai'guang's grandson Yan Baba Left Guard Rate-Fu Aide, bestowed the surname and name Li Chengxu, and gave one thousand strings to establish a household.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Huai'guang's grandson was ennobled Li Chengxu with cash to settle.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，以太子少師蕭昕為工部尚書，致仕，給半祿、料，永為常式。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer, yiwei: Crown Prince Junior Tutor Xiao Xin was made Minister of Works, retired, with half salary and ration permanently as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: Xiao Xin retired as Works minister with half pay.

sentences.zh: 初致仕官只給半祿，無料，上加之以待老臣，半料自昕始也。

translations.literal: At first retired officials received only half salary, no ration; the Emperor added ration to honor old ministers — half ration began with Xin.
translations.idiomatic: Retirees had lacked ration until Xin's pension added half ration.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰，宋州麥一莖九岐者百餘本。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuchen: at Song prefecture wheat with one stalk and nine tassels — more than a hundred plants.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Songzhou reported wheat with nine ears on one stalk.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，以光祿卿裴腆為桂管觀察使。

translations.literal: Sixth month, yiwei: Court of the Imperial Regalia Director Pei Tian was made Guilin observer.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Pei Tian took Guilin.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以嗣滕王湛然為太子賓客、入回紇使。

translations.literal: Seventh month: Heir of Prince of Teng Zhanran was made Crown Prince Guest and envoy to the Uighurs.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Zhanran of Teng became crown prince guest and Uighur envoy.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，以同州刺史竇覦為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinwei: Tong prefect Dou Xian was made Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinwei: Dou Xian entered Revenue.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，詔褚遂良已下至李晟等二十七，圖形於凌煙閣，以繼國初功臣之像。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renxu, edict: from Chu Suiliang down to Li Sheng, twenty-seven — portraits at Lingyan Pavilion to follow the founding ministers' images.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: twenty-seven later ministers joined Lingyan portraits.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，西川韋皋奏與東蠻合力大破吐蕃於故巂州，擒其將臧遮遮。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, bingwu: West River Wei Gao memorialized a great defeat of Tibet at old Xi prefecture with Eastern Man — captive general Zang Zhezhe.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Wei Gao smashed Tibet at Xi and took Zang Zhezhe.

sentences.zh: 自是吐蕃挫銳，竟復巂州。

translations.literal: From this Tibet's edge was blunted; they eventually recovered Xi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan power waned, though Xi was later lost again.

sentences.zh: 庚午，百僚請復徽號，不允。

translations.literal: On gengwu the hundred officials requested restoration of honorific titles — not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the court's plea for honorifics was refused.

sentences.zh: 己丑，易定節度使、檢校司空、平章事張孝忠以擅出兵襲蔚州，降檢校司空為左僕射。

translations.literal: On jichou Yiding commissioner, acting Minister of Works, Associate Director Zhang Xiaozhong, for unauthorized troop dispatch to assault Wei prefecture, was demoted from acting Works to Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Zhang Xiaozhong lost his Works title for raiding Wei.

sentences.zh: 桂管觀察、御史中丞孫晟卒。

translations.literal: Guilin observer, Vice Censor-in-Chief Sun Sheng died.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Sheng died in Guilin.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以戶部侍郎竇覦為揚州長史、兼御史大夫、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: On guisi Vice Minister of Revenue Dou Xian was made Yangzhou senior administrator, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, and Huainan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Dou Xian took Huainan at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，回紇汨咄錄長壽天親昆伽可汗卒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengwu: Uighur Moyanchuo Heavenly Kin Qaghan died.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: the Uighur qaghan died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以淮南節度使杜亞為東都留守、畿汝州都防禦使，兵部侍郎裴住為河南尹，司農卿李翼為陜虢都防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: On xinwei Huainan commissioner Du Ya was made Eastern Capital regent and Ji-Ru overall defense commissioner; War Vice Minister Pei Zhu was made Henan Intendant; Court of the Imperial Granaries Director Li Yi was made Shaan-Guo defense observer.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Du Ya, Pei Zhu, and Li Yi reshuffled eastern and Shaan posts.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以陜虢觀察使杜祐檢校禮部尚書，兼揚州長史、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: On renshen Shaan-Guo observer Du You was made acting Minister of Rites, concurrent Yangzhou senior administrator and Huainan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Du You returned to Huainan with a Rites title.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月戊辰朔。

translations.literal: Sixth year, first month, wuchen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Year 6, first month, wuchen new moon.

sentences.zh: 戊申，大雪。

translations.literal: On wushen great snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen heavy snow.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰朔，百僚會宴於曲江亭，上賦《中和節群臣賜宴》七韻。

translations.literal: Second month, wuchen new moon: the hundred officials banqueted at Qujiang; the Emperor composed seven rhymes on "Mid-Harmony Festival Court Banquet."
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Qujiang banquet with an imperial Mid-Harmony poem.

sentences.zh: 是日，百僚進《兆人本業》三卷，司農獻黍粟各一斗。

translations.literal: That day the hundred officials presented three rolls of "Myriad Peoples' Basic Livelihood"; the Court of the Imperial Granaries offered one peck each of millet and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Officials presented farm manuals; the granary offered millet samples.

sentences.zh: 岐州無憂王寺有佛指骨寸餘，先是取來禁中供養，乙亥，詔送還本寺。

translations.literal: At Worry-Free King Temple in Qi prefecture was a Buddha finger bone over an inch; it had been taken to the palace for worship — on yihai an edict returned it to the original temple.
translations.idiomatic: A Buddha finger relic was sent back to Qi prefecture's temple.

sentences.zh: 珍戌，以中書舍人陸贄權兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: On renxu Secretariat Drafter Lu Zhi was made acting War Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Lu Zhi became acting War vice minister.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以吏部侍郎劉滋為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On jiawu Personnel Vice Minister Liu Zi was made Personnel Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Liu Zi became Personnel minister.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，王武俊守隸州將趙鎬以郡歸李納，武俊怒，以兵攻之。

translations.literal: On dingyou Wang Wu Jun's Su prefecture general Zhao Hao returned the commandery to Li Na; Wu Jun was enraged and attacked with troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Zhao Hao's defection to Li Na drew Wang Wu Jun's attack.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，百僚宴於曲江亭，上賦《上巳詩》一篇賜之。

translations.literal: Third month, gengzi: the hundred officials banqueted at Qujiang; the Emperor composed one "Upper Si Poem" and bestowed it.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Qujiang upper-si banquet with imperial verse.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，渾瑊自河中來朝。

translations.literal: On renyin Hun Zhen came to court from Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Hun Zhen arrived from Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 戊午，牂柯蠻來朝。

translations.literal: On wuwu the Zangke barbarians came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Zangke tribes presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以旱，日色如血，無光。

translations.literal: On jiazi because of drought the sun's color was like blood, without light.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi drought turned the sun blood-red and dim.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，大風雷。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer, jiachen: great wind and thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: wind and thunderstorm.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚申，太白、辰星聚東井。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, gengshen: Venus and Mercury gathered in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month: Venus and Mercury met in the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 戊午，始雨。

translations.literal: On wuwu rain finally began.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the long drought broke.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅朔，上御紫宸受朝。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingyin new moon: the Emperor received audience at Zichen.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingyin: audience at Zichen Hall.

sentences.zh: 上以是月一陰生，臣子道長，父子必以是朔面焉，故取朔日受朝。

translations.literal: Because that month was the first growth of yin, the minister's way lengthened, father and son must face each other on that new moon — therefore he took the new-moon day for audience.
translations.idiomatic: He held new-moon audiences to mark growing yin and filial order.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以寧州刺史範希朝為單于大都護、麟勝節度使。

translations.literal: On renwu Ning prefect Fan Xichao was made Shanyu Grand Protector and Lin-Sheng commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Fan Xichao took Shanyu and Lin-Sheng.

sentences.zh: 是夏，淮南、浙東西、福建等道旱，井泉多涸，人渴乏，疫死者眾。

translations.literal: That summer Huainan, Zhe's east and west, and Fujian circuits droughted; many wells dried; people thirsted; plague deaths were many.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan and the southeast suffered drought, thirst, and plague.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅，淮南節度使竇覦卒。

translations.literal: Seventh month, bingyin: Huainan commissioner Dou Xian died.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Dou Xian died at Huainan.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，復呼親王母曰太妃，公主母曰太儀。

translations.literal: On guiyou consorts' mothers were again called Grand Consort; princesses' mothers were called Grand Mistress.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou titles for imperial mothers were restored.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，工部尚書致仕鮑防卒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingwei: retired Works Minister Bao Fang died.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Bao Fang died.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，收諸道進奏院官印，悉毀之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yichou: seals of memorial-route relay offices were collected and all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: circuit memorial-route seals were abolished.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔：「十一月八日，有事於南郊太廟，行從官吏將士等，一切並令自備食物。

translations.literal: On jimao an edict: "On the eighth day of the eleventh month there will be rites at the Southern Suburb and Imperial Ancestral Temple; all accompanying officials, soldiers, and the like shall supply their own food.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao an edict ordered self-supplied food for the southern suburb rites.

sentences.zh: 其諸司先無公廚者，以本司闕職物充。

translations.literal: Offices that previously lacked public kitchens shall use this office's vacant-post goods.
translations.idiomatic: Offices without kitchens were to use vacant-post goods.

sentences.zh: 其王府官，度支量給廩物。

translations.literal: Princely establishment officials — Revenue shall measure and grant grain rations.
translations.idiomatic: Princely staffs received measured grain from Revenue.

sentences.zh: 其儀仗禮物，並仰御史撙節處分。

translations.literal: Regalia and ritual gifts — all rely on the censorate to restrain and dispose."
translations.idiomatic: Censors were to curb ritual expenses.

sentences.zh: 」冬十月己亥，文武百僚京城道俗抗表請徽號，上曰：「朕以春夏亢旱，粟麥不登，朕精誠祈禱，獲降甘雨，既致豐穰，告謝郊廟。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, jihai: civil and military officials, capital clergy and laity, submitted joint memorials requesting honorific titles; the Emperor said: "I in spring and summer suffered great drought; grain and wheat did not ripen; I prayed sincerely and sweet rain descended; abundance was achieved — I give thanks at suburb and temple.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: the court begged honorifics; the Emperor refused, citing drought ended by prayer.

sentences.zh: 朕倘因禮祀而受徽號，是有為為之。

translations.literal: If I now received honorifics because of ritual sacrifice, that would be doing for effect.
translations.idiomatic: He would not take a title merely from ritual.

sentences.zh: 勿煩固請也。

translations.literal: Do not trouble me with repeated requests."
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，回紇吊祭使、鴻臚卿郭鋒復命，回紇遣達北勒梅錄將軍來，告九姓回紇登里邏沒密施俱錄忠貞昆伽可汗之喪。

translations.literal: On xinhai the Uighur mourning envoy, Court Director Guo Feng, returned; Uighurs sent Tabolei Meilu general to announce the death of the Nine Surnames' Qaghan Dengli Luomei Mishi Julu Zhongzhen Kunjia.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Uighur envoys announced their qaghan's death.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，日南至，上親祀昊天上帝於郊丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengwu: winter solstice; the Emperor personally sacrificed to August Heaven at the suburban mound.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: the Emperor performed solstice sacrifice at the mound.

sentences.zh: 禮畢還宮，御丹鳳樓宣赦，見禁囚徒減罪一等，立仗將士及諸軍兵，賜十作萬段匹。

translations.literal: When the rites ended he returned to the palace, ascended Danfeng Tower, proclaimed amnesty, saw imprisoned convicts and reduced crimes one degree, and bestowed on standing guards and all army soldiers one hundred thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: He returned, amnestied prisoners, and gifted silk to the guards.

sentences.zh: 今後刺史、縣令以四考為限。

translations.literal: Henceforth prefects and magistrates were limited to four performance reviews.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates' terms were capped at four reviews.

sentences.zh: 青州李納以棣州還王武俊，並其兵士三千。

translations.literal: Qing prefecture's Li Na returned Di prefecture to Wang Wu Jun with three thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: Li Na returned Di to Wang Wu Jun with three thousand men.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐蕃陷北庭都護府，節度使楊襲古奔西州。

translations.literal: That year Tibet took the Northern Court Protectorate; commissioner Yang Xigu fled to Xi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet seized the Northern Court; Yang Xigu fled to Xi.

sentences.zh: 回紇大相頡乾迦斯紿襲古，請合軍收復北庭，乃殺襲古，安西因是阻絕，唯西州猶固守之。

translations.literal: Uighur chief minister Yigan Gesi deceived Xigu, requesting joint armies to recover the Northern Court, then killed Xigu; Anxi was thereby cut off — only Xi still held fast.
translations.idiomatic: Uighurs betrayed Yang Xigu and severed Anxi, leaving Xi alone.

sentences.zh: 回紇亦為吐蕃所逼，取浮圖川，乃遷部落羊馬於牙帳之南以避之。

translations.literal: The Uighurs were also pressed by Tibet, took Fotu River, and moved tribes and herds south of the royal camp to avoid them.
translations.idiomatic: Uighurs too fled Tibet, shifting herds south of the royal camp.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月壬戌朔。

translations.literal: Seventh year, first month, renxu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Year 7, first month, renxu new moon.

sentences.zh: 己巳，襄王僙薨。

translations.literal: On jisi Prince of Xiang Zan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Prince Zan of Xiang died.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以湖南觀察使裴胄為洪州刺史、江西觀察使，以常州刺史李衡為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On gengchen Hunan observer Pei Zhou was made Hong prefect and Jiangxi observer; Changzhou prefect Li Heng was made Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Pei Zhou and Li Heng changed Hunan-Jiangxi posts.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，涇原帥劉昌復築平涼城。

translations.literal: Second month, jisi: Jingyuan commander Liu Chang rebuilt Pingliang city.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Liu Chang rebuilt Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 城去故原州一百五十里，本原之屬縣，地當御戎之沖要。

translations.literal: The city was one hundred fifty li from old Yuan prefecture; originally a subordinate county of Yuan, the ground lay on the vital pass against barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: New Pingliang sat on the frontier corridor, far from old Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 昌復浹辰而功畢，分兵戍之，邊患稍弭。

translations.literal: Chang finished the work in a double fortnight, divided troops to garrison it, and border trouble was slightly eased.
translations.idiomatic: He built it in two weeks and eased the border.

sentences.zh: 庚子，侍中渾瑊自河中來朝。

translations.literal: On gengzi Palace Attendant Hun Zhen came to court from Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Hun Zhen came from Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，陳許節度使曲環奏請權停當道冗官，待一二後，民力稍給，則復之。

translations.literal: Third month, xinyou: Chen-Xu commissioner Qu Huan memorialized requesting temporary suspension of redundant posts in the circuit, to restore after one or two years when the people's strength was somewhat supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Qu Huan asked to suspend redundant Chen-Xu posts briefly.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，左龍武統軍戴休顏卒。

translations.literal: On renxu Left Dragon Martial commander-in-chief Dai Xiuyan died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Dai Xiuyan died.

sentences.zh: 甲子，涇原節度使劉昌築胡谷堡，改名彰義堡。

translations.literal: On jiazi Jingyuan commissioner Liu Chang built Hugu Fort, renamed Zhangyi Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Liu Chang built Hugu, renamed Zhangyi.

sentences.zh: 堡在平涼西三十五里，亦御戎之要。

translations.literal: The fort was thirty-five li west of Pingliang — again a key against barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangyi stood thirty-five li west of Pingliang on the frontier line.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔：「頃來賜衣，文彩不常，非制也。

translations.literal: On renshen an edict: "Recently bestowed robes' patterns were irregular — not regulation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict standardized patterns on bestowed robes.

sentences.zh: 朕今思之，宜有定制，節度使宜以鶻銜綬帶，觀察使宜以雁銜威儀。

translations.literal: I now consider it: there should be fixed design — commissioners should use geese holding ribbons; observers should use wild geese holding weiyi."
translations.idiomatic: Commissioners wore geese-with-ribbon; observers, geese-with-auspicious-grass.

sentences.zh: 」威儀，瑞草也。

translations.literal: Weiyi — an auspicious plant.
translations.idiomatic: Weiyi was an auspicious plant.

sentences.zh: 關輔牛疫死，十亡五六。

translations.literal: In the capital region cattle plague killed them — six or seven in ten died.
translations.idiomatic: A cattle plague killed most stock around the capital.

sentences.zh: 上遣中使以諸道兩稅錢賣牛，散給畿民無牛者。

translations.literal: The Emperor sent palace envoys to sell cattle with the two-tax money of the circuits and distribute to capital-region people without cattle.
translations.idiomatic: Palace agents bought cattle with two-tax funds for farmers lacking draft animals.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔神威、神策六軍將士自相訟，軍司推劾；

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict: Divine Awe and Divine Strategy six armies' soldiers suing one another — the army office investigates;
translations.idiomatic: An edict split jurisdiction: army suits to the army office,

sentences.zh: 與百姓相訟，委府縣推劾；

translations.literal: suits with commoners — entrusted to prefectures and counties;
translations.idiomatic: civilian suits to local courts;

sentences.zh: 小事移牒，大事奏取處分，軍司、府縣不得相侵。

translations.literal: small matters by memorandum, great matters memorialized for disposition — army offices and prefectures and counties must not encroach on one another.
translations.idiomatic: major cases went to the throne; neither side could seize the other's cases.

sentences.zh: 癸未，義武軍節度使、檢校司空、平章事張孝忠卒。

translations.literal: On guimao Yiding commissioner, acting Minister of Works, Associate Director Zhang Xiaozhong died.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Zhang Xiaozhong died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，太子少師致仕蕭昕卒。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer, gengzi: retired Crown Prince Junior Tutor Xiao Xin died.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: Xiao Xin died.

sentences.zh: 汴州獻白烏。

translations.literal: Bian prefecture presented a white crow.
translations.idiomatic: Bianzhou sent a white crow.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔：「仲夏之時，萬物敷暢，陽德方茂，陰事始承。

translations.literal: On wuwu an edict: "In midsummer the myriad things flourish; yang virtue is at its height and yin affairs begin to receive.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu an edict proclaimed midsummer audiences of father and son, ruler and minister.

sentences.zh: 昔者觀於法象，因天地交會之序，為父子相見之儀，沿習成風，古今不易。

translations.literal: Formerly observing the emblems, following Heaven-and-earth's meeting sequence, they made the rite of father and son meeting — the custom flowed, ancient and modern unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: The rite followed cosmic yin-yang exchange, an immemorial custom.

sentences.zh: 王者制事，感動因人，酌其情而用中，順其俗以為禮。

translations.literal: The king regulates affairs, moved by feeling and using the people; weighing sentiment and employing the mean, following custom as ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Kings shaped ritual from human feeling and custom.

sentences.zh: 咸覿之義，既行於父子之間；

translations.literal: The meaning of universal sight already operated between father and son;
translations.idiomatic: Filial meeting belonged to the family;

sentences.zh: 資事之情，豈隔君臣之際。

translations.literal: the feeling of supporting affairs — how could it be separated between ruler and minister?
translations.idiomatic: yet ministerial service belonged equally to the court.

sentences.zh: 申恩卿士，自我為初。

translations.literal: Extending grace to the ministers began with me.
translations.idiomatic: He would begin monthly court meetings with his ministers.

sentences.zh: 起今年五月朔，御正殿，召見文武百官，外官因朝奏，咸聽就列。

translations.literal: Starting this year on the fifth month's new moon, at the main hall he summoned civil and military officials; outer officials attending memorial audience might all take their places.
translations.idiomatic: From the fifth month's new moon he held open audiences at Xuanzheng.

sentences.zh: 仍編禮式，以為常典。

translations.literal: Still compile ritual forms as permanent statute.
translations.idiomatic: The form was codified as precedent.

sentences.zh: 」己未，安南首領杜英翰叛，攻都護府，都護高正平憂死。

translations.literal: On jiwei Annan chieftain Du Yinghan rebelled, attacked the protectorate; Protector Gao Zhengping died of grief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Annan rebelled; Protector Gao Zhengping died.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申朔，上御宣政殿見百官，從新制也。

translations.literal: Fifth month, gengshen new moon: the Emperor received audience at Xuanzheng Hall and saw the hundred officials — following the new regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: first Xuanzheng audience under the new rule.

sentences.zh: 辛未，置柔遠軍於安南都護府。

translations.literal: On xinwei Rouyuan army was established at the Annan Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Rouyuan army was posted to Annan.

sentences.zh: 甲申，端王遇薨。

translations.literal: On jiashen Prince of Duan Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Prince of Duan died.

sentences.zh: 許州獻白烏。

translations.literal: Xu prefecture presented a white crow.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou sent a white crow.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以衡州刺史齊映為桂管觀察使。

translations.literal: On wuzi Hengzhou prefect Qi Ying was made Guilin observer.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Qi Ying took Guilin.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子朔。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengzi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month opened on gengzi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太常卿崔縱卒。

translations.literal: On yisi Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director Cui Zong died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Cui Zong died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，以信州刺史鄭叔則為福建觀察使。

translations.literal: Seventh month, gengwu: Xin prefect Zheng Shuzhe was made Fujian observer.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Zheng Shuzhe went to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上幸章敬寺，賦詩九韻，皇太子與群臣畢和，題之寺壁。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Emperor visited Zhangjing Temple, composed nine rhymes; the Crown Prince and ministers all matched and inscribed them on the temple wall.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he visited Zhangjing Temple and left matching poems on the wall.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以邕王謜為義武軍節度使、易定觀察等大使，以定州刺史張升雲為留後。

translations.literal: On wuyin Prince of Yong Zhen was made Yiding commissioner and Yiding observer and related grand commissioner; Ding prefect Zhang Shengyun was made acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Prince Zhen took Yiding; Zhang Shengyun stayed as acting chief.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以虔州刺史趙昌為安南都護、經略招討使。

translations.literal: On gengchen Qian prefect Zhao Chang was made Protector-General of Annan and pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Zhao Chang took Annan.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，以翰林學士歸從敬為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jichou: Hanlin Academician Gui Congjing was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Gui Congjing became Works minister.

sentences.zh: 甲午，給事中鄭瑜為中書舍人。

translations.literal: On jiawu Drafting Attendant Zheng Yu was made Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zheng Yu became a drafter.

sentences.zh: 丙申，貶宗正卿李翰為雅王傅；

translations.literal: On bingchen Court of the Imperial Clan Director Li Han was demoted to Tutor of the Prince of Ya;
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Li Han was demoted to tutor of Prince of Ya;

sentences.zh: 翰林學士陸贄為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Lu Zhi was made War Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhi left Hanlin for War.

sentences.zh: 罷學士。

translations.literal: Hanlin was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Hanlin academy was suspended.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，夏州奏開延化渠，引烏水入庫狄澤，溉田二百頃。

translations.literal: On gengxu Xia prefecture memorialized opening the Yanhua canal, drawing Wushui into Kudize marsh, irrigating two hundred qing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Xia opened a canal irrigating two hundred qing.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，兵部尚書致仕馬炫卒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengshen: retired War Minister Ma Xuan died.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Ma Xuan died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，每御延英令諸司官長二人奏本司事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, guichou: whenever at Yanying the heads of all offices were ordered to report two each on their office's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Yanying audiences required two briefers per office.

sentences.zh: 尋又敕常參官每一日二人引對，訪以政事，謂之巡對。

translations.literal: Soon another edict: each regular attendee two per day to be led in audience, questioned on administration — called "circuit audience."
translations.idiomatic: Daily "circuit audiences" followed for regular officials.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，令常參官趨朝入閣，不得奔走。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yichou: regular attendees entering court for audience must not run.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: running in court was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 周親已下喪者禁慘服，朝會須服本色綾袍金玉帶。

translations.literal: For mourning within five degrees of kin, somber dress was forbidden; at assemblies they must wear their proper colored silk robes with gold-jade belts.
translations.idiomatic: Mourners had to wear court dress, not sackcloth, at assemblies.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以前福建觀察使吳湊為陜州長史、陜虢觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingyou former Fujian observer Wu Cou was made Shaan senior administrator and Shaan-Guo observer.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Wu Cou took Shaan-Guo.

sentences.zh: 是冬無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: No snow fell that winter.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月丙辰朔。

translations.literal: Eighth year, first month, bingchen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Year 8, first month, bingchen new moon.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，罷桂管經略招討使。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Guilin pacification-and-suppression commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Guilin's pacification post was cut.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，許州人李狗兒持杖入含元殿，擊欄檻，又格擒者。

translations.literal: Second month, dinghai: Xu man Li Gou'er with staff entered Hanyuan Hall, struck the balustrades, and also fought captors.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Li Gou'er attacked Hanyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 誅之。

translations.literal: He was executed.
translations.idiomatic: He was put to death.

sentences.zh: 庚子，京師雨土。

translations.literal: On gengzi dust rained on the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi dust fell like rain on Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 己酉，吏部尚書李紓卒。

translations.literal: On jiyou Personnel Minister Li Shu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Li Shu died.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，山南東道節度使、檢校戶部尚書嗣曹王皋薨。

translations.literal: On yichou Shannan East commissioner, acting Revenue Minister, Heir of Prince of Cao Gao died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Gao of Cao died in Shannan East.

sentences.zh: 庚午，宣武軍節度使、司徒、平章事劉玄佐卒。

translations.literal: On gengwu Xuanwu commissioner, Grand Mentor, Associate Director Liu Xuanzuo died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Liu Xuanzuo died.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，劍南西川節度使韋皋奏請，有當道閑員官吏，增其俸祿，從之。

translations.literal: On guiyou Sword-South West commissioner Wei Gao memorialized requesting increased salary for idle circuit officials — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Wei Gao won higher pay for idle western staff.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以湖南觀察使李衡為洪州刺史、江西觀察使。

translations.literal: On jihai Hunan observer Li Heng was made Hong prefect and Jiangxi observer.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Li Heng took Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 襄州軍亂，掠府庫民財殆盡，都將徐誠斬其亂首楊清潭，方止。

translations.literal: Xiangzhou troops mutinied, plundering government stores and people's wealth nearly clean; chief commander Xu Cheng beheaded ringleader Yang Qingtan before it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangzhou mutiny was ended when Xu Cheng killed Yang Qingtan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以荊南節度使樊澤為襄州刺史、山南東道節度使，以江西觀察使裴胄為江陵尹、荊南節度使。

translations.literal: On bingzi Jingnan commissioner Fan Ze was made Xiang prefect and Shannan East commissioner; Jiangxi observer Pei Zhou was made Jiangling Intendant and Jingnan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Fan Ze and Pei Zhou swapped Jingnan and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書班宏判度支，戶部侍郎張滂為諸道鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: Revenue Minister Ban Hong was made judge of revenue; Revenue Vice Minister Zhang Pang was made salt-iron transport commissioner of all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Ban Hong judged revenue; Zhang Pang took salt-iron transport.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以陜虢觀察使吳溱為汴州刺史、宣武軍節度、汴宋等州觀察使。

translations.literal: On jimao Shaan-Guo observer Wu Zhen was made Bian prefect, Xuanwu commissioner, and Bian-Song observer.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Wu Zhen took Xuanwu at Bian.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以同州刺史姚南仲為陜虢觀察使。

translations.literal: On xinsi Tong prefect Yao Nanzhong was made Shaan-Guo observer.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Yao Nanzhong took Shaan-Guo.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以左庶子李充為京兆尹，以蘇州刺史齊抗為潭州刺史、湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: On renwu Left Senior Mentor Li Chong was made Capital Intendant; Suzhou prefect Qi Kang was made Tan prefect and Hunan observer.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Li Chong and Qi Kang took capital and Hunan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，貶左金吾大將軍嗣虢王則之為昭州司馬，左諫議大夫、知制誥吳通玄為泉州司馬，給事中竇申道州司馬。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer, dingchou: Left Golden Guards Grand General Heir of Prince of Guo Zezhi was demoted to Zhaozhou staff officer; Left Remonstrating Censor, Drafting Controller Wu Tongxuan was demoted to Quanzhou staff officer; Drafting Attendant Dou Shen to Daozhou staff officer.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: Zezhi, Wu Tongxuan, and Dou Shen were exiled in the Dou Can purge.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以雅王傅李翰為金吾衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On wuzi Tutor of Prince of Ya Li Han was made Golden Guards Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Li Han was recalled as Golden Guards general.

sentences.zh: 翰前為竇參所惡貶官，至是參敗，上遽召翰，口授將軍，便令金吾仗上事，翌日除書方下。

translations.literal: Han had earlier been demoted by Dou Can's hatred; now Can fell and the Emperor suddenly summoned Han, orally appointing general, ordering Golden Guards attendance at once — the commission document came only the next day.
translations.idiomatic: Li Han was restored overnight when Dou Can fell.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以汴州長史劉士寧為汴州刺史、宣武軍節度使。

translations.literal: On gengyin Bian senior administrator Liu Shining was made Bian prefect and Xuanwu commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Shining seized Xuanwu at Bian.

sentences.zh: 時吳湊行次汜水，聞其有變而還。

translations.literal: At that time Wu Zhen's march had reached Sishui; hearing of the change he returned.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhen turned back at Sishui when he heard.

sentences.zh: 乙未，貶中書侍郎、平章事竇參為郴州別駕，竇申景州司戶。

translations.literal: On yiwei Secretariat Vice Director, Associate Director Dou Can was demoted to Chenzhou registrar; Dou Shen to Jingzhou clerk.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Dou Can and Dou Shen were exiled.

sentences.zh: 尋杖殺申。

translations.literal: Soon Shen was beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Shen was flogged to death soon after.

sentences.zh: 諸竇皆貶。

translations.literal: All the Dou clan were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: The whole Dou clan was banished.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左丞趙憬、兵部侍郎陸贄為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Left Vice Minister Zhao Jing and War Vice Minister Lu Zhi were made Secretariat Vice Directors and Associate Grand Secretariat Directors.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Jing and Lu Zhi replaced the Dous as chancellors.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，韋皋請十二而稅，以給官吏，從之。

translations.literal: On dingyou Wei Gao requested twelve parts in ten as tax to pay officials — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Wei Gao's twelve-tenths tax for officials was allowed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以東都、河南、淮南、江南、嶺南、山南東道兩稅等物，令戶部侍郎張滂主之；

translations.literal: On bingwu the two-tax goods of the eastern capital, Henan, Huainan, Jiangnan, and Lingnan, and Shannan East were placed under Revenue Vice Minister Zhang Pang;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Pang took eastern two-tax revenues;

sentences.zh: 以河內、河東、劍南、山南西道等財，戶部尚書、判度支班宏主之。

translations.literal: the wealth of the interior, Hedong, Sword-South, and Shannan West under Revenue Minister and revenue judge Ban Hong.
translations.idiomatic: Ban Hong held the western two-tax, as in the Dali Liu Yan–Han Huang division.

sentences.zh: 一遵大歷故事，如劉晏、韓滉分掌焉。

translations.literal: Altogether following the great Dali precedent, as when Liu Yan and Han Huang divided charge.
translations.idiomatic: The split revived Liu Yan and Han Huang's old division.

sentences.zh: 給事中韋夏卿左遷常州刺史，坐交諸竇也。

translations.literal: Drafting Attendant Wei Xiaqing was transferred left to Changzhou prefect for associating with the Dou clan.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Xiaqing was exiled for Dou ties.

sentences.zh: 是月，吐蕃寇靈州。

translations.literal: That month Tibet raided Ling prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Tibet raided Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯朔，上御宣政殿受朝。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yimao new moon: the Emperor received audience at Xuanzheng.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Xuanzheng audience.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，初增稅京兆青苗畝三錢，以給掌閑彍騎。

translations.literal: On bingchen the green-crop tax on the capital region was first increased three cash per mu to supply palace stud and falconry.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the capital green-crop tax rose three cash per mu for palace studs.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以光祿少卿崔穆為黔州觀察使。

translations.literal: On wuwu Court of the Imperial Regalia Junior Director Cui Mu was made Qian observer.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Cui Mu took Qian.

sentences.zh: 己未，大風，吹壞廬舍、門闕。

translations.literal: On jiwei great wind blew down dwellings and gate towers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei a gale wrecked houses and gates.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以大理卿王翃為福建觀察使。

translations.literal: On bingyin Grand Court Judge Wang Hong was made Fujian observer.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Wang Hong took Fujian.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，初令授臺省官者各具舉主於授官詔。

translations.literal: On wuchen it was first ordered that those receiving Censorate and Secretariat posts must each name a recommender on the appointment edict.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen palace appointees had to name their sponsors on the edict.

sentences.zh: 先是郎官缺，左右丞舉之，御史缺，大夫、中丞舉之，詔書不具所舉。

translations.literal: Previously when bureau director posts were vacant the Vice Directors recommended; when censor posts were vacant the Censor-in-Chief and Vice Censor recommended — the edict did not list who recommended.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier sponsors were unnamed on appointment edicts.

sentences.zh: 及趙憬、陸贄為相，建議郎官不宜專於左右丞，宜令尚書、丞、郎各舉其可，詔書具所舉官名，御史亦如之，異日考殿最以舉主能否。

translations.literal: When Zhao Jing and Lu Zhi became chancellors they proposed that bureau directors should not be monopolized by the Vice Directors — Ministers, Vice Ministers, and bureau directors should each recommend the able; the edict should list the recommender's name, and censors likewise; later performance review would grade the recommender's ability.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao and Lu required named sponsors accountable at review time.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The reform was approved.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，平盧淄青節度使、檢校司徒、平章事李納卒。

translations.literal: On guiyou Pinglu-Zi-Qing commissioner, acting Grand Mentor, Associate Director Li Na died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Na died.

sentences.zh: 癸未，前太僕少卿劉士干有罪賜死，劉玄佐養子也。

translations.literal: On guimao former Court of the Imperial Stud Junior Director Liu Shigan, guilty, was granted death — Li Xuanzuo's adopted son.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Liu Shigan, Xuanzuo's adopted son, was executed.

sentences.zh: 六月，吐蕃寇涇州。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Tibet raided Jing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Tibet raided Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅朔，戶部尚書、判度支蕭國公班宏卒。

translations.literal: Seventh month, jiayin new moon: Revenue Minister and revenue judge Duke of Xiao Ban Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Ban Hong died.

sentences.zh: 以桂管觀察使齊映為洪州刺史、江西觀察使；

translations.literal: Guilin observer Qi Ying was made Hong prefect and Jiangxi observer;
translations.idiomatic: Qi Ying went to Jiangxi;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士歸崇敬為兵部尚書，致仕。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Gui Chongjing was made War Minister, retired.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Chongjing retired as War minister.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大雨。

translations.literal: On xinsi great rain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi torrential rain.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，以天下水災，分命朝臣宣撫賑貸。

translations.literal: Eighth month, yichou: because of empire-wide flood, court ministers were dispatched to proclaim relief and loans.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: flood envoys were sent to forty-odd circuits.

sentences.zh: 河南、河北、山南、江淮凡四十餘州大水，漂溺死者二萬餘人。

translations.literal: Henan, Hebei, Shannan, and Jiang-Huai — more than forty prefectures great flood; drowned dead more than twenty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Floods drowned over twenty thousand across the east.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以青州刺史李師古為鄆州大都督府長史、平盧淄青等州節度觀察海運陸運、押新羅渤海兩蕃等使。

translations.literal: On xinmao Qing prefect Li Shigu was made Yan metropolitan senior administrator, Pinglu-Zi-Qing commissioner, sea and land transport, and commissioner over Silla, Bohai, and the two barbarian realms.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Shigu inherited Li Na's Yan and Pinglu command.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔以歲兇罷九日賜宴。

translations.literal: On dingwei an edict because of famine year canceled the Double Ninth banquet gift.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei famine canceled the Double Ninth feast grants.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，韋皋攻吐蕃之維州，獲蕃將論莽熱以獻。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingsi: Wei Gao attacked Tibet's Wei prefecture and presented captive general Lun Mangre.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Wei Gao took Lun Mangre at Wei prefecture.

sentences.zh: 貶太子賓客於邵江州別駕，尋卒。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Guest Yu Shao was demoted to Jiangzhou registrar; soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Shao was exiled to Jiangzhou and soon died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以太子賓客薛玨為嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: On yihai Crown Prince Guest Xue Jue was made Lingnan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Xue Jue took Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，追封故皇弟遐為均王。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, jihai: posthumously enfeoffed the late imperial younger brother Xia as Prince of Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Prince Xia was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Jun.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，復命金吾置門籍。

translations.literal: On gengxu Golden Guards gate registers were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Golden Guards gate books returned.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renzi new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己巳，貶左庶子姜公輔泉州別駕。

translations.literal: On jisi Left Senior Mentor Jiang Gongfu was demoted to Quanzhou registrar.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Jiang Gongfu was exiled.

sentences.zh: 嚴震奏破吐蕃於芳州。

translations.literal: Yan Zhen memorialized defeating Tibet at Fang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhen reported victory over Tibet at Fang.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔自今死刑勿決，先杖。

translations.literal: On renshen an edict: henceforth do not first execute capital punishment by beating.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen beating before execution of capital convicts was banned.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，詔賜遭水縣乏絕戶米三十萬石。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengyin, edict: bestow thirty thousand shi of grain to flood-stricken counties with exhausted households.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: thirty thousand shi of relief grain for flood counties.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以給事中李巽為潭州刺史、湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingwei Drafting Attendant Li Xun was made Tan prefect and Hunan observer.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Li Xun took Hunan.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸酉，門下省奏：「郵驛條式，應給紙券。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, guiyou: the Chancellery memorialized: "Relay regulations should supply paper vouchers.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month: the Chancellery regulated relay vouchers.

sentences.zh: 除門下外，諸使諸州不得給往還券，至所詣州府納之，別給俾還朝。

translations.literal: Except the Chancellery, all envoys and prefectures must not issue round-trip vouchers; at the destination prefecture they are surrendered and separate vouchers given for return to court.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Chancellery might issue return vouchers.

sentences.zh: 常參官在外除授及分司假寧往來，並給券。

translations.literal: Regular attendees appointed outside or on leave traveling back and forth — all receive vouchers."
translations.idiomatic: Regular officials on assignment also received vouchers.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the memorial.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，牂柯、室韋、靺鞨皆使朝貢。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Zangke, Shiwei, and Mohe all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu several frontier peoples presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月庚辰朔，朝賀畢，上賦《退朝觀仗歸營詩》。

translations.literal: Ninth year, first month, gengchen new moon: after congratulatory audience the Emperor composed "Poem on Returning from Court to View the Guard Camps."
translations.idiomatic: Year 9, first month: after audience he composed a guard-camp poem.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，劍南東川節度使王叔邕來朝。

translations.literal: On yiyou Sword-South East commissioner Wang Shuyong came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Wang Shuyong came from Sword-South East.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，初稅茶，歲得錢四十萬貫，從鹽鐵使張滂所奏。

translations.literal: On guimao the tea tax was first imposed — four hundred thousand strings yearly — as salt-iron commissioner Zhang Pang memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Zhang Pang inaugurated the tea tax at four hundred thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 茶之有稅，自此始也。

translations.literal: Tax on tea began from this.
translations.idiomatic: State tea taxation began here.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，禁賣劍銅器。

translations.literal: On jiachen selling swords and copper vessels was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen private sale of swords and copperware was banned.

sentences.zh: 天下有銅山，任人採取，其銅官買，除鑄鏡外，不得鑄造。

translations.literal: Where the empire had copper mountains, people might mine; the copper the government bought — except mirrors, no casting.
translations.idiomatic: Private mining was allowed but minting was state-controlled except mirrors.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌朔。

translations.literal: Second month, gengxu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Second month began on gengxu.

sentences.zh: 先是宰相以三節賜宴，府縣有供帳之弊，請以宴錢分給，各令諸司選勝宴會，從之。

translations.literal: Previously chancellors on the three festivals received banquets while prefectures and counties had provisioning abuses; they requested dividing the banquet money for each office to choose scenic feasts — approved.
translations.idiomatic: Festival banquet cash replaced costly local provisioning.

sentences.zh: 是日中和節宰相宴於曲江亭，諸司隨便，自是分宴焉。

translations.literal: That day on Mid-Harmony chancellors banqueted at Qujiang; each office as convenient — from this separate banquets.
translations.idiomatic: Mid-Harmony became separate office feasts at Qujiang.

sentences.zh: 易定留守張升雲為義武軍節度使。

translations.literal: Yiding acting commissioner Zhang Shengyun became Yiding commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shengyun became full Yiding commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔復築鹽州城。

translations.literal: On xinyou an edict restored building Yan prefecture's walls.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Yan prefecture's walls were ordered rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 貞元三年，城為吐蕃所毀，自是塞外無堡障，犬戎入寇，既城之後，邊患息焉。

translations.literal: Zhenyuan 3 the city was destroyed by Tibet; from then the outer frontier had no forts; the dog barbarians raided — after the city, border trouble ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Yan's rebuild ended raids after years without frontier forts.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，以駕部郎中、知制誥張式為虢州刺史。

translations.literal: Third month, jihai: Chariotry Bureau director, Drafting Controller Zhang Shi was made Guo prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Zhang Shi became Guo prefect.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉，地震，有聲如雷，河中、關輔尤甚，壞城壁廬舍，地裂水湧。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer, xinyou: earthquake with sound like thunder; Hezhong and the capital region worst — city walls and dwellings ruined, ground split and water gushed.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: a thunderous earthquake wrecked Hezhong and the capital.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，廢諸州府執刀。

translations.literal: Fifth month, gengshen: saber-bearers of all prefectures and prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: prefectural saber-bearers were cut.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以義成軍節度使、檢校右僕射賈耽為左僕射、同中書門下平章事，以尚書左丞盧邁本官同平章事。

translations.literal: On jiachen Yicheng commissioner, acting Right Vice Director Jia Dan was made Left Vice Director and Associate Director; Personnel Left Vice Minister Lu Mai became Associate Director at his substantive rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Jia Dan and Lu Mai entered the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 以鄭州刺史李融為滑州刺史、義成軍節度使。

translations.literal: Zheng prefect Li Rong was made Hua prefect and Yicheng commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Rong took Yicheng at Hua.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，韋皋奏，遣軍出西山，破吐蕃峨和城、定廉城、通鶴軍，凡平堡五十餘所。

translations.literal: On yisi Wei Gao memorialized dispatching troops west of the mountains, breaking Tibet's Ehe city, Dinglian city, and Tonghe army — in all more than fifty forts pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Wei Gao reported fifty western forts taken from Tibet.

sentences.zh: 是日以蕃俘器仗來獻。

translations.literal: That day Tibetan captives and weapons were presented.
translations.idiomatic: Captives and arms were presented that day.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以門下侍郎、平章事董晉為禮部尚書，罷知政事。

translations.literal: On bingxu Chancellery Vice Director, Associate Director Dong Jin was made Minister of Rites and left government.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Dong Jin left the chancellery for Rites.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，加韋皋檢校右僕射，以司農少卿裴延齡為戶部侍郎、判度支。

translations.literal: On jiayin Wei Gao was made acting Right Vice Director; Court of the Imperial Granaries Junior Director Pei Yanling was made Revenue Vice Minister and revenue judge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Wei Gao gained a vice title; Pei Yanling took revenue.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以給事中李衡為戶部侍郎、諸道鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: On gengshen Drafting Attendant Li Heng was made Revenue Vice Minister and salt-iron transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Li Heng took transport.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，敕縣令以四考為限，無替者宜至五考。

translations.literal: Seventh month, jiwei, edict: magistrates with four reviews as limit — those without replacement might go to five reviews.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: magistrates might serve five terms if unreplaced.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以信州刺史孫公器為邕管經略使。

translations.literal: On gengzi Xin prefect Sun Gongqi was made Yong circuit pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Sun Gongqi took Yong pacification.

sentences.zh: 故事，宰相秉筆決事，每人十日一易。

translations.literal: By precedent chancellors held the brush and decided affairs — each man ten days then changed.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellors had rotated the drafting brush every ten days.

sentences.zh: 至是賈耽、趙憬、陸贄、盧邁同平章政事，百僚有所關白，更相讓而不言。

translations.literal: Now Jia Dan, Zhao Jing, Lu Zhi, and Lu Mai were all Associate Directors; when the hundred officials had business they yielded to one another and did not speak.
translations.idiomatic: Four chancellors now deferred to one another in silence.

sentences.zh: 始詔令旬日秉筆，後詔每日更秉筆。

translations.literal: It was first decreed a ten-day turn holding the brush; later decreed daily rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Brush duty shifted from ten-day to daily turns.

sentences.zh: 劍南西山羌女國王湯立志、哥鄰王董臥庭、白狗王羅陀匆、弱水王董避和、逋租王弟鄧告知、南水王侄尚悉曩等六國君王，自來朝貢。

translations.literal: Sword-South western hills — Queen of the Woman State Tang Lizhi, King of Ge Geguo Wang Dongwuting, King of White Dog Luo Tuocong, King of Weak Water Dong Bihe, King of Bozu Wang Di Denggao, King of South Water Wang Zhi Shangxinang, and six other realm kings came themselves to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Six western queens and kings presented tribute in person.

sentences.zh: 六國初附吐蕃，韋皋擊西山討吐蕃，故六蠻內附，各授官秩遣之。

translations.literal: The six realms had first attached to Tibet; Wei Gao struck the western hills to attack Tibet, so the six barbarians submitted inward, each granted office rank and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Gao's campaign brought six tribes in from Tibet.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，太尉、中書令、西平郡王李晟薨，贈太師，廢朝五日。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengxu: Grand Preceptor, Secretariat Director, Prince of Xiping Li Sheng died — posthumously Grand Preceptor, court mourning five days.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Li Sheng died; five days' mourning.

sentences.zh: 己巳，皇太子長男廣陵王淳納妃郭氏。

translations.literal: On jisi the Crown Prince's eldest son, Prince of Guangling Chun, received Lady Guo as consort.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Crown Prince Chun married Lady Guo.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，罷九日宴，以太師晟喪也。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jimao: the Double Ninth banquet was canceled because of Grand Preceptor Sheng's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Double Ninth feast canceled for Li Sheng's death.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，侍中馬燧對於延英。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, jiyou: Palace Attendant Ma Sui answered at Yanying.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Ma Sui attended Yanying.

sentences.zh: 燧足疾，詔令不拜，行僕於地，命宦者扶持之。

translations.literal: Sui had foot ailment; an edict ordered no bow; he walked prostrate on the ground; eunuchs were ordered to support him.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Sui, lame, was helped before the throne without bowing.

sentences.zh: 止謂之曰：「前日卿與太尉晟俱來，今公獨至。

translations.literal: The Emperor only said to him: "Before you came with Grand Preceptor Sheng; now you alone come."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wept that only Ma Sui remained of the old pair.

sentences.zh: 」因歔欷泣下。

translations.literal: He sighed and wept.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor broke into sighs and tears.

sentences.zh: 及燧退，上送及階。

translations.literal: When Sui withdrew the Emperor saw him to the steps.
translations.idiomatic: He walked Ma Sui down the steps.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，環王國獻犀牛，上令見於太廟。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Huan kingdom presented a rhinoceros; the Emperor ordered it shown at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou a rhinoceros tribute was displayed at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，日南至，上親郊圓丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yiyou: winter solstice; the Emperor personally sacrificed at the round mound.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: solstice sacrifice at the round mound.

sentences.zh: 是日還宮，御丹鳳樓，制曰：「朕以寡德，祗膺大寶，勵精理道，十有五年。

translations.literal: That day returning to the palace, at Danfeng Tower he decreed: "I with slight virtue have received the great mandate, striving to refine the Way fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: Returning from the mound he issued a solstice amnesty edict.

sentences.zh: 夙夜惟寅，罔敢自逸，小大之務，莫不祗勤。

translations.literal: Dawn and dusk reverent, not daring ease; great and small affairs — none not reverently labored.
translations.idiomatic: He claimed fifteen years of unceasing labor.

sentences.zh: 皇靈懷顧，宗社垂祐，年穀豐阜，荒服會同，遠至邇安，中外咸若。
