translations.literal: The imperial numen cared, the altars aided; years' grain abundant; distant realms assembled; far and near at peace; inside and outside alike.
translations.idiomatic: He credited Heaven with harvest and peace.

sentences.zh: 永惟多祐，實荷玄休。

translations.literal: Ever thinking of much blessing — truly bearing mysterious grace.
translations.idiomatic: He felt deep gratitude for divine favor.

sentences.zh: 是用虔奉禮章，躬薦郊廟，克展因心之敬，獲申報三之誠。

translations.literal: Therefore reverently observing ritual statutes, personally offering at suburb and temple, able to display inward reverence, obtaining to report the threefold sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: The rites expressed his sincerity to Heaven and ancestors.

sentences.zh: 慶感滋深，悚惕惟勵，大福所賜，豈獨在予，思與萬方，均其惠澤，可大赦天下。

translations.literal: Joy and feeling ever deeper, fear and caution ever more urged — the great blessing bestowed cannot rest on me alone; I wish with the myriad regions to share its gracious favor; a great amnesty of the empire is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a general amnesty to share the blessing.

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，華州潼關鎮國軍、隴右節度使李元諒卒於良原，以其部將阿史那敘統元諒之眾，戍良原。

translations.literal: On xinmao Hua Tong Pass Zhenguo army, Longyou commissioner Li Yuanliang died at Liangyuan; his officer Ashina Xu led Yuanliang's troops to garrison Liangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Yuanliang died; Ashina Xu held Liangyuan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，河南尹、東都留守裴住卒。

translations.literal: On renyin Henan Intendant, Eastern Capital regent Pei Zhu died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Pei Zhu died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰制以冬薦官，宜令尚書丞、郎於都堂訪以理術，試時務狀，考其通否及歷任考課事跡，定為三等，並舉主姓名。

translations.literal: On jiachen an edict for winter recommendation officers: Ministers and bureau directors at the main hall should inquire into governance arts, test current-affairs memoranda, examine competence and prior review records, fix three grades, and list recommender names.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen winter promotion exams were ordered at the main hall.

sentences.zh: 仍令御史一人為監試。

translations.literal: Still order one censor as supervising examiner.
translations.idiomatic: A censor supervised the tests.

sentences.zh: 如授官後政事能否，委御史臺、觀察使以聞，而殿最舉主。

translations.literal: If after appointment administrative ability fails, entrust the Censorate and observers to report — and grade the recommender.
translations.idiomatic: Sponsors would be graded on their nominees' performance.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午朔，制：「今後使府判官、副使、行軍已下，使罷後，如是檢校試五品以上官，不合集於吏部選，任準罷使郎官、御史例，冬季聞奏。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingwu new moon, edict: "Henceforth after commissioners' adjutants, deputies, and field staff below end service, if acting or trial fifth rank and above, they do not assemble at Personnel for selection — follow the precedent of ended-service bureau directors and censors: in winter report to court."
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: ended circuit staff reported in winter, not at Personnel.

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，宣武軍亂，逐節度使劉士寧。

translations.literal: On bingchen Xuanwu army mutinied and expelled commissioner Liu Shining.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Xuanwu troops drove out Liu Shining.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以通王諶為宣武軍節度使，以宣武軍節度副使李萬榮為汴州刺史、宣武軍節度、汴宋等州觀察留後。

translations.literal: On renxu Prince of Tong Zhen was made Xuanwu commissioner; Xuanwu deputy Li Wanrong was made Bian prefect, Xuanwu commissioner, and Bian-Song acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Wanrong replaced Liu Shining at Xuanwu.

sentences.zh: 朔方靈鹽節度副大使、太子少師、檢校左僕射、餘姚郡王杜希全卒。

translations.literal: Shuofang Ling-Salt deputy commissioner, Crown Prince Junior Tutor, acting Left Vice Director, Duke of Yuyao Du Xiquan died.
translations.idiomatic: Du Xiquan died on the Shuofang frontier.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月乙亥朔。

translations.literal: Tenth year, first month, yihai new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Year 10, first month, yihai new moon.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以虔王諒為朔方靈鹽豐節度大使，以朔方等道行軍司馬李欒為留後。

translations.literal: On yiyou Prince of Qian Liang was made Shuofang Ling-Salt-Feng commissioner; Shuofang field staff officer Li Luan was made acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Li Luan acted for Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，南詔異牟尋大破吐蕃於神川，使來獻捷。

translations.literal: On renchen Nanzhao Yimouxun greatly defeated Tibet at Shenchuan and sent envoys presenting victory.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Nanzhao crushed Tibet and sent news.

sentences.zh: 己亥，昭義節度使、檢校司空平章事李抱真請降官，乃授檢校左僕射。

translations.literal: On jihai Zhaoyi commissioner, acting Minister of Works, Associate Director Li Baozhen requested lowered rank — he was made acting Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Li Baozhen demoted himself to vice director.

sentences.zh: 時抱真病，巫祝言宜降爵，故有是請。

translations.literal: At the time Baozhen was ill; shamans said he should lower his title — hence the request.
translations.idiomatic: Illness and omens prompted his demotion request.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，以瀛州刺史劉澭為秦州刺史、隴右經略軍使、理普潤縣，仍以普潤軍為名。

translations.literal: Second month, bingwu: Ying prefect Liu Zun was made Qin prefect, Longyou pacification commander, administering Pu-run county, still naming the army Pu-run.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Liu Zun took Longyou at Pu-run.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以給事中齊抗為河南尹。

translations.literal: On yimao Drafting Attendant Qi Kang was made Henan Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Qi Kang became Henan Intendant.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，義成軍節度使、鄭滑觀察使李融卒。

translations.literal: On yichou Yicheng commissioner, Zheng-Hua observer Li Rong died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Li Rong died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔：「君臣之際，義莫重焉，每聞薨殂，良深悼惻。

translations.literal: On dingmao an edict: "Between ruler and minister the meaning is nowhere heavier; whenever I hear of death my grief is deep.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao an edict raised funeral grants for deceased officials.

sentences.zh: 應文武朝臣薨卒者，其月俸、料宜全給，仍更準本官一月俸料，以為賻贈。

translations.literal: For civil and military court officials who die, that month's salary and ration should be paid in full, and still one month's salary and ration at former rank as burial gift."
translations.idiomatic: Survivors received full month pay plus a burial month's stipend.

sentences.zh: 」三月乙亥，黃霧四塞，日無光。

translations.literal: Third month, yihai: yellow fog filled the four quarters; the sun had no light.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: yellow fog darkened the sky.

sentences.zh: 以華州刺史李復為滑州刺史、義成軍節度使。

translations.literal: Hua prefect Li Fu was made Hua prefect and Yicheng commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fu took Yicheng at Hua.

sentences.zh: 滄州程懷直來朝，賜安業坊宅，妓一人，復令還鎮。

translations.literal: Cangzhou Cheng Huaizhi came to court; Anye Ward residence, one courtesan, was bestowed; he was ordered back to his command.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Huaizhi was feasted, gifted, and sent back to Cang.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，南詔異牟尋攻收吐蕃鐵橋已東城壘一十六，擒其王五人，降其民眾十萬口。

translations.literal: On gengchen Nanzhao Yimouxun attacked and recovered sixteen walled places east of Tibet's Iron Bridge, captured five kings, and reduced one hundred thousand of their people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Nanzhao took sixteen forts east of the Iron Bridge.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以同州刺史盧征為華州刺史、潼關防禦、鎮國軍等使。

translations.literal: On renshen Tong prefect Lu Zheng was made Hua prefect, Tong Pass defense, and Zhenguo army commander.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Lu Zheng took Tong Pass and Zhenguo.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以延州刺史李如暹所部蕃落賜名曰安塞軍，以如暹為軍使。

translations.literal: On xinchou Yan prefect Li Ruxian's tribal troops were granted the name Anse army; Ruxian was made army commander.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Li Ruxian's tribes became the Anse army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰，地震，癸丑復震。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer, wuchen: earthquake; on guichou again.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: earthquakes on wuchen and guichou.

sentences.zh: 恆州奏見巨人跡。

translations.literal: Heng prefecture memorialized giant footprints seen.
translations.idiomatic: Hengzhou reported giant footprints.

sentences.zh: 以雲南告捷使高細龍為左武衛將軍。

translations.literal: The Yunnan victory envoy Gao Xilong was made Left Martial Guard general.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xilong of the Yunnan mission gained a guard post.

sentences.zh: 是月，太白晝見。

translations.literal: That month Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: That month Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 有大鳥飛集宮中，食雜骨。

translations.literal: A great bird flew gathering in the palace, eating assorted bones.
translations.idiomatic: A great bird fed on bones within the palace.

sentences.zh: 是春霖雨，罕有晴日。

translations.literal: That spring continuous rain — rarely a clear day.
translations.idiomatic: Spring brought endless rain.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅朔。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renyin new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth month opened on renyin.

sentences.zh: 昭義軍節度使、檢校左僕射、同中書門下平章事、義陽王李抱真卒，詔以其將王延貴權知昭義軍事。

translations.literal: Zhaoyi commissioner, acting Left Vice Director, Associate Director, Prince of Yiyang Li Baozhen died — an edict ordered his general Wang Yangu to act as Zhaoyi commander.
translations.idiomatic: Li Baozhen died; Wang Yangu acted for Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以祠部郎中袁滋兼御史中丞，為冊南詔使。

translations.literal: On guichou Sacrifices Bureau director Yuan Zi was made concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief and envoy to enfeoff Nanzhao.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Yuan Zi was sent to enfeoff Nanzhao.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以辰州刺史房孺復為容管經略使。

translations.literal: On jiayin Chen prefect Fang Rufu was made Rong circuit pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Fang Rufu took Rong pacification.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，韋皋奏西山峨和城擊破吐蕃城柵，斬首二千八百級。

translations.literal: On bingyin Wei Gao memorialized breaking Tibetan walls at western Ehe city — beheaded two thousand eight hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Wei Gao reported 2,800 heads at Ehe.

sentences.zh: 庚午，度支使裴延齡兼靈、鹽等州鹽池井榷使。

translations.literal: On gengwu Revenue commissioner Pei Yanling was made concurrent Ling-Salt and other salt ponds and wells monopoly commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Pei Yanling took frontier salt monopoly.

sentences.zh: 辛未晦，有水鳥集於左藏庫，是夜暴雨，大風折木。

translations.literal: Last day of the month, xinwei: water birds gathered at the Left Treasury; that night violent rain and great wind broke trees.
translations.idiomatic: Month's end: birds at the treasury, then storm.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申朔，以邕朔，以邕王謜為昭義軍節度使，以昭義軍押衙王延貴為潞府左司馬，充昭義節度留後，賜名虔休。

translations.literal: Seventh month, renshen new moon: Prince of Yong Zhen was made Zhaoyi commissioner; Zhaoyi escort officer Wang Yangu was made Lu prefect left staff officer, acting Zhaoyi commissioner, bestowed name Qianxiu.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Prince Zhen took Zhaoyi; Wang Yangu was renamed Qianxiu as acting chief.

sentences.zh: 抱真別將權知洺州事元誼不悅虔休為留後，據洺州叛，陰結田緒。

translations.literal: Baozhen's separate general acting Ming prefect Yuan Yi disliked Qianxiu as acting commissioner, held Ming and rebelled, secretly joining Tian Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Yi rebelled at Ming, rejecting Qianxiu and allying with Tian Xu.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，賜南詔異牟尋金印銀窠，其文曰「貞元冊南詔印」。

translations.literal: On gengchen Nanzhao Yimouxun was bestowed a gold seal with silver socket; the inscription read "Zhenyuan Enfeoffment Nanzhao Seal."
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Nanzhao received the "Zhenyuan Enfeoffment Nanzhao" seal.

sentences.zh: 先是，吐蕃以金印授南詔，韋皋因其舊而請之。

translations.literal: Previously Tibet had granted Nanzhao a gold seal; Wei Gao used that precedent to request it.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Gao replaced Tibet's seal with the court's.

sentences.zh: 汴州軍亂，攻節度留後李萬榮，不勝而潰，萬榮悉捕斬其孥。

translations.literal: Bianzhou troops mutinied, attacked acting commissioner Li Wanrong, did not win and dispersed; Wanrong captured and executed all their families.
translations.idiomatic: Bian mutineers failed; Wanrong slaughtered their families.

sentences.zh: 己亥，前汴州節度使劉士寧宜於郴州安置，飲州守鎮黃少卿叛，攻邕管經略使孫公器，又陷欽、橫、潯、貴等州。

translations.literal: On jihai former Bian commissioner Liu Shining was to be settled at Chen; Yin prefect Huang Shaoqing rebelled, attacked Yong pacification commissioner Sun Gongqi, and also took Qin, Heng, Xun, and Gui prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Liu Shining was exiled to Chen; Huang Shaoqing ravaged the south.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃大將論乞髯、陽沒藏、悉諾硉以其家內附，授歸義將軍。

translations.literal: Tibetan generals Lun Qiran, Yang Meizang, and Xinuo'lu led their households to submit inward — made Return-to-Righteousness generals.
translations.idiomatic: Three Tibetan generals defected with their households.

sentences.zh: 因置四品已下武官，以授四夷歸附者，仍定懷化大將軍已下俸錢。

translations.literal: Therefore military posts below fourth rank were established to grant the four barbarians who submitted, and salaries were fixed from Huaihua Grand General downward.
translations.idiomatic: New posts and pay were set for barbarian defectors.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未朔，以袁州刺史董鎮為邕管經略使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinwei new moon: Yuan prefect Dong Zhen was made Yong pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Dong Zhen took Yong pacification.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賜百僚九日宴，上賦詩賜之。

translations.literal: On wuzi the hundred officials received the Double Ninth banquet; the Emperor composed poetry and bestowed it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Double Ninth banquet returned with imperial verse.

sentences.zh: 辛卯。

translations.literal: On xinmao.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Nanzhao's tribute arrived at court.

sentences.zh: 南詔獻鐸槊、浪人劍、吐蕃印八紐。

translations.literal: Nanzhao presented iron spears, wave-people swords, and eight Tibetan seals.
translations.idiomatic: Nanzhao sent arms and Tibetan seals.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，定州張升雲改名茂昭。

translations.literal: On wuxu Ding prefect Zhang Shengyun changed his name to Maozhao.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zhang Shengyun became Zhang Maozhao.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，御宣政殿，試賢良方正、能直言極諫等舉人。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, guimao: at Xuanzheng Hall tested Worthy and Good, Direct Speech, and other candidates.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: civil-service candidates were examined at Xuanzheng.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，刑部尚書劉滋卒。

translations.literal: On renxu Minister of Justice Liu Zi died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Liu Zi died.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，諸道鹽鐵轉運使張滂為衛尉卿，以浙西觀察使王緯為諸道鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yiyou: salt-iron transport commissioner Zhang Pang was made Court Director; Zhexi observer Wang Wei was made salt-iron transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Wang Wei replaced Zhang Pang at transport.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，秘書監致仕穆寧卒。

translations.literal: On gengyin retired Secretariat Director Mu Ning died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Mu Ning died.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子朔。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengzi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth month opened on gengzi.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，貶中書侍郎、平章事陸贄為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On renxu Secretariat Vice Director, Associate Director Lu Zhi was demoted to Crown Prince Guest.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Lu Zhi fell from the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月庚午朔。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, first month, gengwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Year 11, first month, gengwu new moon.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，嶺南節度使薛玨卒。

translations.literal: On yihai Lingnan commissioner Xue Jue died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Xue Jue died.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以秘書少監王礎為黔中經略觀察使，衛尉少卿武少儀為邕管經略使。

translations.literal: On yiwei Secretariat Junior Director Wang Chu was made Qianzhong pacification observer; Court Director Junior Director Wu Shaoyi was made Yong pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Wang Chu and Wu Shaoyi took Qianzhong and Yong.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以邕管經略使王鍔為廣州刺史、嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: On bingshen Yong pacification commissioner Wang Gao was made Guangzhou prefect and Lingnan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wang Gao took Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，以衢州刺史李若初為福建觀察使。

translations.literal: Second month, guimao: Quzhou prefect Li Ruochu was made Fujian observer.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Li Ruochu took Fujian.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，岫渤海大欽茂之子嵩為渤海郡王、忽汗州都督。

translations.literal: On yisi Bohai Great Khan Qinmao's son Song was made Prince of Bohai and Governor of Hohan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Bohai's heir Song was enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，於涇州彰信堡置潘原縣。

translations.literal: On yimao at Jing prefecture Zhangxin Fort Pan yuan county was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Pan yuan county was founded at Zhangxin Fort.

sentences.zh: 甲子，九姓回紇骨咄祿昆伽奉誠可汗卒。

translations.literal: On jiazi the Nine Surnames' Uighur Kutlug Qaghan Chongcheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Uighur qaghan died.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，司徒兼侍中馬燧以疾請罷侍中，不許。

translations.literal: Third month, gengwu: Grand Mentor concurrent Palace Attendant Ma Sui requested removal of Palace Attendant because of illness — not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Ma Sui's resignation as attendant was refused.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賜宰臣兩省供奉官宴於曲江亭。

translations.literal: On xinwei chancellors and the two departments' supply officials were feasted at Qujiang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the chancellors banqueted at Qujiang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以吏部侍郎鄭瑜為河南、淮南水陸轉運使。

translations.literal: On yichou Personnel Vice Minister Zheng Yu was made Henan and Huainan land-and-water transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zheng Yu took Henan-Huainan transport.

sentences.zh: 丙申，諸州準例薦隱居丘園不求聞達蔡廣成等九人，各授試官，令給公乘，到京日量才敘用。

translations.literal: On bingshen nine recluses including Cai Guangcheng of hill and garden not seeking fame were recommended by all prefectures by precedent — each granted trial office, given public carriage, to be ranked by talent on reaching the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen nine hermits received trial posts and carriages to the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，旱。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer: drought.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: drought.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，貶太子賓客陸贄為忠州別駕，京兆尹李充信州長史，衛尉卿張滂汀州長史。

translations.literal: On renxu Crown Prince Guest Lu Zhi was demoted to Zhongzhou registrar; Capital Intendant Li Chong to Xin senior administrator; Court Director Zhang Pang to Ting senior administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Lu Zhi, Li Chong, and Zhang Pang were exiled in Pei Yanling's purge.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以兵部侍郎韓皋為京兆尹。

translations.literal: On guihai War Vice Minister Han Gao was made Capital Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Han Gao became capital intendant.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賜南詔敕書，始列中書三官奉宣行，復舊制也。

translations.literal: On jiazi Nanzhao was granted an imperial letter — for the first time the three Secretariat officials' "received and promulgated" line appeared, restoring old regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Nanzhao's letter restored the three-drafter promulgation line.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幽州劉濟奏大破奚王啜剌等六萬餘眾。

translations.literal: On bingyin Youzhou Liu Ji memorialized great defeat of Xi king Zhuola and others — more than sixty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Liu Ji crushed the Xi.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯朔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingmao new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month opened on dingmao.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命有司慮囚，旱故也。

translations.literal: On gengwu the relevant office reviewed prisoners — because of drought.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu drought prompted a prison review.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以宣武留後李萬榮為汴州刺史、宣武節度副使、知節度事。

translations.literal: On dingchou Xuanwu acting commissioner Li Wanrong was made Bian prefect, Xuanwu deputy, and knowing commissioner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Wanrong was confirmed at Xuanwu.

sentences.zh: 以昭義軍節度留後王虔休為潞州大都督府長史、昭義軍節度副大使、知節度事、管內度支營田、潞澤磁邢洺觀察使。

translations.literal: Zhaoyi acting commissioner Wang Yangu was made Lu metropolitan senior administrator, Zhaoyi deputy commissioner, knowing commissioner affairs, and commissioner of Lu-Ze-Ci-Xing-Ming observation.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yangu took full Zhaoyi command at Lu.

sentences.zh: 又以朔方留後李欒為靈州大都督府長史、朔方靈鹽豐夏四州受降定遠城天德軍節度副大使、知節度事、管內度支營田觀察押蕃落等使。

translations.literal: Also Shuofang acting commissioner Li Luan was made Ling metropolitan senior administrator, Shuofang Ling-Salt-Feng-Xia four prefectures' surrender, Dingyuan city, Tiande army deputy commissioner, knowing commissioner affairs, and commissioner of revenue, farming, observation, and barbarian control.
translations.idiomatic: Li Luan was confirmed over Shuofang and the northwest garrisons.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以河東節度使、檢校工部尚書、太原尹李自良卒。

translations.literal: On jiashen Hedong commissioner, acting War Minister, Taiyuan Intendant Li Ziliang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Li Ziliang died at Hedong.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，遣使冊九姓回紇騰里羅羽錄沒密施合胡六骨咄祿毗伽懷信可汗。

translations.literal: On gengyin envoys were sent to enfeoff the Nine Surnames' Uighur Tengri Bolu Mishi Hehu Liugu Piqie Huaixin Qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the new Uighur qaghan was enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以通王諶為河東節度使，以河東行軍司馬李悅為河東節度營田觀察留後、北都副留守。

translations.literal: On guisi Prince of Tong Zhen was made Hedong commissioner; Hedong field staff officer Li Yue was made Hedong revenue-farming observer acting commissioner and Northern Capital deputy regent.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Li Yue acted for Hedong when Prince Zhen was named.

sentences.zh: 甲午，初鑄河東監軍印。

translations.literal: On jiawu the Hedong army-supervisor seal was first cast.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Hedong's army-supervisor seal was first cast.

sentences.zh: 監軍有印，自王定遠始也。

translations.literal: Army supervisors having seals began with Wang Dingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Army-supervisor seals began with Wang Dingyuan.

sentences.zh: 六月，河陽獻白烏。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Heyang presented a white crow.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Heyang sent a white crow.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，晉慈隰觀察使崔漢衡卒。

translations.literal: On jiachen Jin-Ci-Long observer Cui Hanheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Cui Hanheng died.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以絳州刺史姚齊梧為晉慈隰都防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: On guichou Jiang prefect Yao Qiwei was made Jin-Ci-Long overall defense observer.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Yao Qiwei took Jin-Ci-Long.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅朔，右諫議大夫陽城為國子司業。

translations.literal: Seventh month, bingyin new moon: Right Remonstrating Censor Yang Cheng was made Court of the Heir Apparent Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Yang Cheng entered the heir's court.

sentences.zh: 河東監軍王定遠配流崖州，坐專殺也。

translations.literal: Hedong army supervisor Wang Dingyuan was exiled to Yazhou for unauthorized killing.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dingyuan was banished for murder in Hedong.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，江西觀察使、洪州刺史齊映卒。

translations.literal: On xinmao Jiangxi observer, Hong prefect Qi Ying died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Qi Ying died.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，司徒兼侍中、北平郡王馬燧薨，贈太傅。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinhai: Grand Mentor concurrent Palace Attendant, Prince of Beiping Ma Sui died — posthumously Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Ma Sui died; he was posthumously Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以楚州刺史路寰為洪州刺史、江西觀察使。

translations.literal: On bingchen Chu prefect Lu Huan was made Hong prefect and Jiangxi observer.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Lu Huan took Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 閏月己丑，國子司業裴澄表上《乘輿月令》十一卷，《禮典》十二卷。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, jichou: Court of the Heir Apparent Vice Director Pei Cheng submitted eleven rolls of "Imperial Carriage Monthly Ordinances" and twelve rolls of "Ritual Canon."
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month: Pei Cheng presented ritual compendiums.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，賜宰臣兩省供奉官宴於曲江，賦詩六韻賜之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jimao: chancellors and the two departments' supply officials were feasted at Qujiang; a six-rhyme poem was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Qujiang feast with imperial verse for the chancellors.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，加韋皋統押近界諸蠻及西山八國、雲南安撫等使。

translations.literal: On dingsi Wei Gao was made overall commissioner pacifying nearby barbarians, the western hills' eight realms, and Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Wei Gao's western pacification titles expanded.

sentences.zh: 滄州大將程懷信逐其帥程懷直。

translations.literal: Cangzhou great general Cheng Huaixin expelled his commander Cheng Huaizhi.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Huaixin drove out Cheng Huaizhi at Cang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，以虔王諒為橫海軍節度大使，以兵馬使程懷信為留後。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, dingchou: Prince of Qian Liang was made Heng-hai army commissioner; army commander Cheng Huaixin was made acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Cheng Huaixin took Heng-hai.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，日南至，不受朝賀，以司徒馬燧葬也。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, bingchen: winter solstice — court congratulations not received because of Grand Tutor Ma Sui's funeral.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: solstice rites were omitted for Ma Sui's funeral.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太常定馬燧謚曰「景武」，上曰：「景，太祖謚，改莊武可也。

translations.literal: On xinchou the Court of Imperial Sacrifices fixed Ma Sui's posthumous title as "Jingwu"; the Emperor said: "Jing was Taizu's posthumous title — change to Zhuangwu."
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Ma Sui's posthumous title was changed from Jingwu to Zhuangwu.

sentences.zh: 」己酉，潭州獻赤烏。

translations.literal: On jiyou Tan prefecture presented a red crow.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Tanzhou sent a red crow.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，上獵苑中，戎多殺，止行三驅之禮，勞士而還。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuchen: the Emperor hunted in the park; many were killed; he stopped at the three-drive rite, comforted the soldiers, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: a curtailed park hunt honored the troops.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月甲午朔。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, first month, jiawu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Year 12, first month, jiawu new moon.

sentences.zh: 庚子，元誼、李文通率洺州兵五千、民五萬家東奔田緒。

translations.literal: On gengzi Yuan Yi and Li Wentong led five thousand Ming troops and fifty thousand households east to Tian Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Yuan Yi and Li Wentong fled Ming for Tian Xu.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以前滄州節度使程懷直為左龍武統軍。

translations.literal: On renzi former Cang commissioner Cheng Huaizhi was made Left Dragon Martial commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Cheng Huaizhi entered the capital guard.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，成德軍節度使、檢校司徒、兼侍中渾瑊兼中書令；

translations.literal: On yichou Chengde commissioner, acting Grand Mentor, concurrent Palace Attendant Hun Zhen was made concurrent Secretariat Director;
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Hun Zhen and several frontier lords gained chancellor titles;

sentences.zh: 興元節度使嚴震、魏博田緒、西川韋皋並加檢校左右僕射、中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Xingyuan commissioner Yan Zhen, Weibo Tian Xu, and Sword-South West Wei Gao were all made acting Left and Right Vice Directors and Associate Directors.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhen, Tian Xu, and Wei Gao joined them as acting chancellors.

sentences.zh: 於是方鎮皆敘進兼官。

translations.literal: Then regional commanders all reported advanced concurrent posts.
translations.idiomatic: Regional strongmen thereafter piled on honorary chancellor ranks.

sentences.zh: 上制《貞元廣利藥方》五百八十六首，頒降天下。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed five hundred eighty-six recipes of "Zhenyuan Broad Benefit Medicinals" and distributed them under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: He issued five hundred eighty-six imperial medical formulas empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳。

translations.literal: Third month, guisi.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guisi day.

sentences.zh: 甲午，韋皋奏收降蠻七千戶，得吐蕃所賜金字告身五十五片。

translations.literal: On jiawu Wei Gao memorialized receiving the surrender of seven thousand barbarian households and fifty-five gold-letter commission documents Tibet had granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Wei Gao reported seven thousand submits and Tibetan commissions.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以戶部侍郎裴延齡為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On yisi Revenue Vice Minister Pei Yanling was made Revenue Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Pei Yanling became Revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以兵部尚書董晉充東都留守、判東都尚書省、東畿汝州都防禦使。

translations.literal: On wushen War Minister Dong Jin was made Eastern Capital regent, judge of Eastern Capital Secretariat, and Ji-Ru overall defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Dong Jin became eastern regent.

sentences.zh: 四月壬戌朔。

translations.literal: Fourth month, renxu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth month opened on renxu.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，左右十軍使奏：去年冬車駕幸諸營，欲於銀臺亭子門外立碑以紀聖跡。

translations.literal: On wuchen the Left and Right Ten Armies memorialized: last winter when the carriage visited the camps they wished to erect a stele outside the Yintai pavilion gate to record the sage's trace — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen army steles at Yintai were authorized.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 庚午、魏情節度使、度支營田觀察使，檢校左僕射、平章事、魏州長史、駙馬都尉、雁門郡王田緒卒。

translations.literal: On gengwu Wei Bo commissioner, revenue-farming observer, acting Left Vice Director, Associate Director, Wei prefect senior administrator, imperial son-in-law, Prince of Yanmen Tian Xu died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Tian Xu of Weibo died.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上降誕日，命沙門、道士加文儒官討論三教，上大悅。

translations.literal: On gengchen the Emperor's birthday — he ordered monks, Daoists, and literati officials to debate the three teachings; the Emperor was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen his birthday debate of the three teachings pleased him.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯朔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinmao new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month opened on xinmao.

sentences.zh: 丙申，邠寧節度使張獻甫卒。

translations.literal: On bingshen Binning commissioner Zhang Xianfu died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zhang Xianfu died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以邠寧都虞候楊朝晟為邠州刺史、邠寧、慶節度使。

translations.literal: On jiachen Binning Chief Commandant Yang Chaocheng was made Bin prefect and Binning-Qing commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Yang Chaocheng succeeded at Binning.

sentences.zh: 銀夏節度使韓潭讓新授禮部尚書，乞雪崔寧，許其家收葬。

translations.literal: Yin-Xia commissioner Han Tan yielded the newly appointed Minister of Rites post, begging to clear Cui Ning's name — the family was permitted to bury him.
translations.idiomatic: Han Tan gave up Rites to clear Cui Ning for burial.

sentences.zh: 丁已，駙馬郭暖、王士平、曖弟煦暄，坐代宗忌辰飲宴，貶官歸第。

translations.literal: On dingsi imperial sons-in-law Guo Ai, Wang Shiping, and Ai's brothers Xu and Xuan, for feasting on Daizong's death anniversary, were demoted and sent to their residences.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi princesses' husbands were punished for feast on Daizong's death day.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，故驩州司戶竇參，許其家收葬。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renxu: former Huan prefecture clerk Dou Can — his family was permitted to bury him.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Dou Can's family might bury him.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，初置左右護軍中尉監、中護軍監，以授宦官。

translations.literal: On yichou Left and Right Protecting Army Central Attendant Supervisors and Central Protecting Army Supervisors were first established — to be granted to eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou eunuch army-supervisor posts were created.

sentences.zh: 以左右神策軍使竇文場、霍仙鳴為左右神策護軍中尉監，以左右神威軍使張尚進、焦希望為左右神威中護軍監。

translations.literal: Left and Right Divine Strategy army commanders Dou Wenchang and Huo Xianming were made Left and Right Divine Strategy Protecting Army Central Attendant Supervisors; Left and Right Divine Awe army commanders Zhang Shangjin and Jiao Xiwang were made Left and Right Divine Awe Central Protecting Army Supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Wenchang, Huo Xianming, Zhang Shangjin, and Jiao Xiwang took the new eunuch commands.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，宣歙觀察使、宣州刺史劉贊卒。

translations.literal: On xinsi Xuan-She observer, Xuan prefect Liu Zan died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Liu Zan died.

sentences.zh: 七月乙未，以東都留守、兵部尚書董晉檢校左僕射、同中書目門下平章事、汴州刺史、宣武軍節度使、宋亳潁觀察使。

translations.literal: Seventh month, yiwei: Eastern Capital regent, War Minister Dong Jin was made acting Left Vice Director, Associate Director, Bian prefect, Xuanwu commissioner, and Song-Bian-Ying observer.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Dong Jin was sent to quiet Bian after Wanrong's chaos.

sentences.zh: 時李萬榮病，萬榮子乃自署為兵馬使，軍人又逐乃，汴州亂，故命董晉帥之。

translations.literal: At the time Li Wanrong was ill; Wanrong's son then self-appointed as army commander; the troops again expelled him — Bian chaos; therefore Dong Jin was ordered to command it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wanrong's son had worsened the Bian mutiny, forcing Dong Jin's appointment.

sentences.zh: 以太子賓客為東都留守、判東都尚書省事、東畿汝都防禦使。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Guest Li Chong was made Eastern Capital regent, judge of Eastern Capital Secretariat, and Ji-Ru overall defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chong became Luoyang regent when Dong Jin went to Bian.

sentences.zh: 是日，汴州節度使李萬榮卒。

translations.literal: That day Xuanwu commissioner Li Wanrong died.
translations.idiomatic: That day Li Wanrong died.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinwei new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以前魏博節度副使田季安為魏州長史、魏博節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: On jisi former Weibo deputy Tian Ji'an was made Wei senior administrator and Weibo observer.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Tian Ji'an inherited Weibo.

sentences.zh: 庚午，增修望仙門，廣夾城、十王宅、六王宅。

translations.literal: On gengwu Wangxian Gate was enlarged; the flanking city, Ten Princes' Residence, and Six Princes' Residence were expanded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Wangxian Gate and princely quarters were enlarged.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以虢州刺史崔衍為宣、歙、池觀察使，以乞髯子湯忠義為歸德將軍。

translations.literal: On guiyou Guo prefect Cui Yan was made Xuan-She-Chi observer; Qiran's son Tang Zhongyi was made Return-to-Righteousness general.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Cui Yan and Tang Zhongyi received posts.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以汝州刺史陸長源為宣武行軍司馬。

translations.literal: On bingzi Ru prefect Lu Changyuan was made Xuanwu field staff officer.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Lu Changyuan became Xuanwu staff officer.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，門下侍郎、平章事趙憬薨。

translations.literal: On bingxu Chancellery Vice Director, Associate Director Zhao Jing died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zhao Jing died.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，以河東行軍司馬李景略為豐州刺史、天德軍豐州西受降城都防禦使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiawu: Hedong field staff officer Li Jinglue was made Feng prefect and Tiande army Feng western surrender city overall defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Li Jinglue took Tiande at Feng.

sentences.zh: 丙午，戶部尚書、判度支裴延齡卒。

translations.literal: On bingwu Revenue Minister and revenue judge Pei Yanling died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Pei Yanling died.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，幸魚藻宮，即日還內。

translations.literal: On gengxu the Emperor visited Yuzao Palace and the same day returned within.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he visited Yuzao Palace briefly.

sentences.zh: 壬子，吐蕃寇慶州。

translations.literal: On renzi Tibet raided Qing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Tibet raided Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，詔以京畿旱，放租稅。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, renxu, edict: because of capital-region drought, land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: drought brought capital tax relief.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，諫議大夫崔損、給事中趙宗儒並同中書門下平章事，俱賜金紫。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Remonstrating Censor Cui Sun and Drafting Attendant Zhao Zongru were both made Associate Directors — both bestowed gold-purple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Cui Sun and Zhao Zongru entered the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 以少府監崔穆為晉州刺史、晉慈隰觀察使。

translations.literal: Court of the Imperial Regalia Director Cui Mu was made Jin prefect and Jin-Ci-Long observer.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Mu took Jin-Ci-Long.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，昭義王虔休造《誕聖樂曲》以獻。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinmao: Zhaoyi's Wang Qianxiu composed "Birth-of-the-Sage Music" and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Wang Qianxiu presented celebratory music.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，大雪平地二尺，竹柏多死。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiwei: snow level two chi; bamboo and cypress mostly died.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: deep snow killed bamboo and cypress.

sentences.zh: 環王國所獻犀牛，甚珍愛之，是冬亦死。

translations.literal: The Huan kingdom's presented rhinoceros, greatly cherished — that winter it also died.
translations.idiomatic: The treasured rhinoceros died that winter.

sentences.zh: 上著《刑政箴》一首。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed one "Admonition on Punishments and Government."
translations.idiomatic: He wrote an "Admonition on Punishments and Government."

sentences.zh: 癸未，回紇、南詔、劍南西山國女國王並朝賀。

translations.literal: On guimao Uighur, Nanzhao, and Sword-South western hills Woman Realm queen all came to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Uighur, Nanzhao, and western queens attended court.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月戊子朔。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, first month, wuzi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Year 13, first month, wuzi new moon.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太子少師致仕關播卒。

translations.literal: On gengyin retired Crown Prince Junior Tutor Guan Bo died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Guan Bo died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，吐蕃贊普遣使修好，塞上以聞，上以犬戎負約，不受其使。

translations.literal: On renyin the Tibetan qaghan sent envoys seeking good relations; the frontier reported — the Emperor, because the dog barbarians had broken faith, did not receive the envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Tibetan peace envoys were refused.

sentences.zh: 東都尚書省火。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital Secretariat burned.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang's Secretariat caught fire.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，賜宰臣、兩省供奉官宴於曲江亭。

translations.literal: Second month, dingsi: chancellors and the two departments' supply officials were feasted at Qujiang.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Qujiang chancellors' feast.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，度支郎中蘇弁為戶部侍郎、判度支，兵部郎中王紹判戶部。

translations.literal: On yihai Revenue Bureau director Su Bian was made Revenue Vice Minister and revenue judge; War Bureau director Wang Shao judged Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Su Bian and Wang Shao took revenue posts.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，造會慶亭於麟德殿前。

translations.literal: Third month, wuzi: Huiching Pavilion was built before Linde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Huiching Pavilion rose before Linde.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以福建都團練使李若初為明州刺史、浙東觀察使，以婺州刺史柳冕為福建觀察使。

translations.literal: On yisi Fujian united training commissioner Li Ruochu was made Ming prefect and Zhedong observer; Wu prefect Liu Mian was made Fujian observer.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Li Ruochu and Liu Mian swapped Zhe and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬戌，上幸興慶宮龍堂祈雨。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer, renxu: the Emperor visited Xingqing Palace Dragon Hall to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: rain prayer at Xingqing.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大雪。

translations.literal: On yichou great snow.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou heavy snow.

sentences.zh: 庚午，義成軍節度使、鄭滑觀察營田、檢校左僕射、滑州刺史李復卒。

translations.literal: On gengwu Yicheng commissioner, Zheng-Hua observer and farming, acting Left Vice Director, Hua prefect Li Fu died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Li Fu died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以大理卿于頔為陜州長史、陜虢觀察使。

translations.literal: On jimao Grand Court Judge Yu Di was made Shaan senior administrator and Shaan-Guo observer.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Yu Di took Shaan-Guo.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以陜虢都防禦觀察轉運等使姚南仲為滑州刺史、義成軍節度、鄭滑觀察使。

translations.literal: On gengchen Shaan-Guo overall defense observer and transport commissioner Yao Nanzhong was made Hua prefect, Yicheng commissioner, and Zheng-Hua observer.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Yao Nanzhong took Yicheng at Hua.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌朔，韋皋收復巂州，畫圖來上。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingxu new moon: Wei Gao recovered Xi prefecture and sent a map upward.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Wei Gao recovered Xi and sent a map.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以庫部郎中、翰林學士鄭餘慶為工部侍郎、知吏部選事。

translations.literal: On renzi Treasury Bureau director, Hanlin Academician Zheng Yuqing was made War Vice Minister and knowing Personnel selection.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Zheng Yuqing took War and Personnel selection.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯朔，以衡州刺史陳云為邕管經略使。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jimao new moon: Heng prefect Chen Yun was made Yong pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Chen Yun took Yong pacification.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，引龍首渠水自通化門入，至太清宮前。

translations.literal: On xinsi Longshou canal water was led from Tonghua Gate to before the Supreme Ultimate Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Longshou canal reached the Supreme Ultimate Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬午，韋皋奏於巂州破吐蕃，生擒大籠官士人，馬畜器械不可勝紀。

translations.literal: On renwu Wei Gao memorialized breaking Tibet at Xi prefecture — captive great-nest officer and people, horses, tools beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Wei Gao reported a great Xi victory over Tibet.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙戌，宰相盧邁請告累月，四表避相位，是日，命宰臣問疾於盧邁私第。

translations.literal: Seventh month, bingxu: Chancellor Lu Mai requested leave for many months; four memorials avoided the chancellorship — that day chancellors were ordered to inquire after illness at Lu Mai's private residence.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: the court visited the ailing Lu Mai.

sentences.zh: 己丑，右神策中尉霍仙鳴病，賜馬十匹，令於諸寺齋僧。

translations.literal: On jichou Right Divine Strategy Central Attendant Supervisor Huo Xianming was ill — ten horses bestowed, ordered to feed monks at various temples.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the ill Huo Xianming received horses and temple prayers.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，浚湖渠、魚藻池，深五尺。

translations.literal: On renchen lake canals and Yuzao Pool were dredged five chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen lakes and Yuzao Pool were dredged.

sentences.zh: 乙未，地震。

translations.literal: On yiwei earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以兵部郎中、判戶部王紹為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: On jiawu War Bureau director, judging Revenue Wang Shao was made Revenue Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Wang Shao became Revenue vice minister.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔今後嗣王薨葬，所司並供鹵簿，永為常式。

translations.literal: On yichou an edict: henceforth when enfeoffed imperial sons die and are buried, the relevant office shall supply funeral escort — permanently as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou enfeoffed princes' funerals were granted full escort.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，詔京兆尹韓皋修昆明池石炭、賀蘭兩堰兼湖渠。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingsi, edict: Capital Intendant Han Gao should repair Kunming Pool's Shitan and Helan two weirs and the lake canals.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Han Gao was ordered to repair Kunming Pool and canals.

sentences.zh: 壬午，容管經略使房孺復卒。

translations.literal: On renwu Rong pacification commissioner Fang Rufu died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Fang Rufu died.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，盧邁懇讓相位，乃授太子賓客。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jichou: Lu Mai earnestly yielded the chancellorship — he was made Crown Prince Guest.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Lu Mai left the chancellery for the heir's court.

sentences.zh: 辛卯九日，宴宰臣百官於曲江，上賦詩以賜之。

translations.literal: On xinmao Double Ninth day: chancellors and the hundred officials were banqueted at Qujiang; the Emperor composed poetry and bestowed it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Double Ninth Qujiang banquet returned with imperial verse.

sentences.zh: 己未，江西觀察使路寰卒。

translations.literal: On jiwei Jiangxi observer Lu Huan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Lu Huan died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，升定州為大都督府。

translations.literal: On jiachen Ding Prefecture was elevated to a great metropolitan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Dingzhou became a great metropolitan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以湖南觀察使李巽為江州刺史、江西觀察使，以禮部侍郎呂渭為潭州刺史、湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: Hunan observation commissioner Li Xun was made Jiangzhou prefect and Jiangxi observation commissioner; Libu vice minister Lü Wei was made Tanzhou prefect and Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xun moved from Hunan to Jiangxi; Lü Wei became Hunan commissioner at Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑朔，以前滁州刺史房濟為容管經略使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, guichou new moon: former Chuzhou prefect Fang Ji was made Rongguan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth month's new moon Fang Ji became Rongguan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，黔中觀察使奏：「溪州人戶訴，被前刺史魏從琚於兩稅外，每年加進硃砂一千斤、水銀二百馱，戶民疾苦，請停。

translations.literal: On bingchen the Qianzhong observation commissioner memorialized: "Xizhou households petition that the former prefect Wei Congju, beyond the two taxes, each year added tribute of one thousand jin of cinnabar and two hundred loads of mercury — the people suffer; we ask that it stop.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianzhong commissioner reported Xizhou's plea: ex-prefect Wei Congju had levied cinnabar and mercury beyond the two-tax quota.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: It was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted the request.

sentences.zh: 淮西吳少誠擅開淘刁河、汝河，詔使不能禁。

translations.literal: Huai-Xi Wu Shaocheng on his own authority opened the Taodiao and Ru rivers; imperial envoys could not forbid it.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shaocheng of Huai-Xi dredged the Taodiao and Ru rivers despite imperial orders.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，宰相賈耽以疾避相位，不允。

translations.literal: On guiyou Chancellor Jia Dan, ill, sought to avoid the chancellorship — not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Jia Dan, ill, asked to leave the chancellery and was refused.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，徐泗節度使張建封來朝，上嘉之，次日於延英召對。

translations.literal: On dingchou Xu-Si military commissioner Zhang Jianfeng came to court; the emperor praised him, and the next day summoned him for discussion at Yanying.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Zhang Jianfeng of Xu-Si was received at court and praised; the next day he was questioned at Yanying.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，贈太傅馬燧祔廟，命所司供少牢祭，仍給鹵簿，從宅至廟。

translations.literal: On guisi posthumous Grand Tutor Ma Sui was enshrined in the ancestral temple; the authorities were ordered to supply a lesser offering, and still to provide funeral regalia from his residence to the temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Ma Sui entered the ancestral temple with full rites and escort from his house.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，右龍武統軍韓游瑰卒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengchen: Right Dragon Martial commanding general Han Yougui died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Han Yougui died.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月壬午朔。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, renwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Spring of the fourteenth year opened on renwu.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔諸道州府應貞元八年至十一年兩稅及榷酒錢，在百姓腹內者，總五百六十萬七千貫，並除放。

translations.literal: On gengyin an edict: all circuit and prefectural two-tax levies and monopoly wine monies from Zhenyuan years eight through eleven still owed by the people — in all 5,607,000 strings — were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the court remitted 5,607,000 strings of back taxes and wine levies from Zhenyuan 8–11.

sentences.zh: 甲午，敕：「比來朝官或相過從，金吾皆上聞。

translations.literal: On jiawu an edict: "Of late when court officials visit one another, the Golden Guards report all of it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict said: "The Golden Guards have been reporting every visit among court officials.

sentences.zh: 其間如是親故，或嘗同僚，伏臘歲時，須有還往，亦人倫常禮，今後不須奏聞。

translations.literal: Among them, if they are kin or former colleagues, at solstice seasons there must be exchanges — this too is human custom; hereafter it need not be reported."
translations.idiomatic: Kin and former colleagues may visit at the seasons — that is ordinary courtesy; no more reports are required."

sentences.zh: 」因張建封奏議也。

translations.literal: This followed a memorial from Zhang Jianfeng.
translations.idiomatic: The change followed Zhang Jianfeng's advice.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子朔。

translations.literal: Second month, renzi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The second month opened on renzi.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上御麟德殿，宴文武百僚，初奏《破陳樂》，遍奏《九部樂》，及宮中歌舞妓十數人列於庭。

translations.literal: On wuwu the emperor attended Lindé Hall and feasted civil and military officials; first the "Breaking Chen" music was played, then the Nine Sections through, and more than ten palace singing girls and dancers were ranged in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he banqueted officials at Lindé Hall with the "Breaking Chen" suite, the Nine Sections, and palace dancers.

sentences.zh: 先是上制《中和樂舞曲》，是日奏之，日晏方罷。

translations.literal: Earlier the emperor had composed the "Central Harmony" dance tune; that day it was performed, and only at sunset did it end.
translations.idiomatic: He had composed the "Central Harmony" dance, performed that day until dusk.

sentences.zh: 比詔二月一日中和節宴，以雨雪，改用此日。

translations.literal: The prior edict had set the first day of the second month for the Central Harmony festival feast; because of rain and snow, this day was used instead.
translations.idiomatic: Rain had forced the Central Harmony feast from its usual date to this day.

sentences.zh: 上又賦《中春麟德殿宴群臣詩》八韻，群臣頒賜有差。

translations.literal: The emperor also composed an eight-rhyme poem, "Midspring Banquet for Officials at Lindé Hall," and distributed gifts to the ministers in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: He gave an eight-line banquet poem and graded gifts to the assembly.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賜光蔡節度曰彰義軍。

translations.literal: On yihai the Guang-Cai command was named the Zhangyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Guang-Cai was renamed the Zhangyi Army.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，右神策行營節度、鳳翔隴右觀察使、檢校尚書右僕射、鳳翔尹邢君牙卒。

translations.literal: Third month, bingshen: Right Divine Strategy campaign commissioner, Fengxiang-Longyou observation commissioner, acting Minister of the Right, Fengxiang prefect Xing Junya died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Xing Junya of Fengxiang died.

sentences.zh: 以右神策將軍張昌為鳳翔尹、右神策行營節度、鳳翔隴右節度使，仍改名敬則。

translations.literal: Right Divine Strategy general Zhang Chang was made Fengxiang prefect, Right Divine Strategy campaign commissioner, and Fengxiang-Longyou military commissioner, and his name was changed to Jingze.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chang became Fengxiang commissioner as Jingze.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，以左諫議大夫、平章事崔損為修奉八陵使。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, yichou: Left Remonstrance Bureau grandee and Grand Secretariat Associate Cui Sun was made commissioner for repairing the eight imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Cui Sun was charged with restoring the eight mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 先是昭陵寢殿為火所焚，至是獻、昭、乾、定、泰五陵各造屋三百八十間，橋、元、建三陵據闕補造。

translations.literal: Earlier the Zhaoling sleeping hall had been burned; now Xian, Zhao, Qian, Ding, and Tai tombs each received three hundred eighty new rooms, while Qiao, Yuan, and Jian tombs were patched where lacking.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhaoling burned, five tombs gained new halls and three were repaired where damaged.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰朔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, gengchen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month opened on gengchen.

sentences.zh: 甲午，前東都留守、東畿汝都防禦使、檢校吏部尚書杜亞卒。

translations.literal: On jiawu former Luoyang protector, eastern capital Ji-Ru defense commissioner, acting Minister of Personnel Du Ya died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Du Ya died.

sentences.zh: 丙午，戶部侍郎、判度支蘇弁為太子詹事。

translations.literal: On bingwu Revenue vice minister and acting transport controller Su Bian was made heir-apparent household steward.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Su Bian became steward of the heir's household.

sentences.zh: 上特召度支郎中於䪹於延英，兼御史中丞，賜金紫，令判度支。

translations.literal: The emperor specially summoned Revenue section chief Yu Mian to Yanying, concurrently made him vice censor-in-chief, granted gold and purple, and ordered him to act as transport controller.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Mian was summoned to Yanying, made vice censor-in-chief, and put in charge of revenue.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚申，以左神策行營節度韓全義為夏州刺史，兼鹽、夏、綏、銀節度使，以代韓潭。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, gengshen: Left Divine Strategy campaign commissioner Han Quanyi was made Xiazhou prefect and concurrent Yan, Xia, Sui, and Yin military commissioner, replacing Han Tan.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Han Quanyi took the Yan-Xia-Sui-Yin command from Han Tan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，貶太子詹事蘇弁為汀州司戶，兄贊善大夫袞為永州司戶，兄贊善大夫袞為永州司戶，前京兆府士曹冕為信州司戶。

translations.literal: On jiazi heir-apparent household steward Su Bian was demoted to Tingzhou registrar; elder brother senior aide to the heir Gun to Yongzhou registrar; elder brother senior aide to the heir Gun to Yongzhou registrar; former Capital Metropolitan Prefecture legal clerk Mian to Xinzhou registrar.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Su Bian and his brothers were demoted to distant registrarships, with Mian sent to Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，太子賓客盧邁卒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guimao: heir-apparent guest Lu Mai died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Lu Mai died.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以旱儉，出太倉粟賑貸。

translations.literal: On yisi because of drought and famine, grain from the great storehouse was issued for relief loans.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi famine grain was lent from the imperial granary.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以吉州刺史杜春為邕管經略使。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Jizhou prefect Du Chun was made Yongguan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Du Chun became Yongguan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，貶京兆尹韓皋為撫州司馬。

translations.literal: On maomao Capital Metropolitan Prefect Han Gao was demoted to Fuzhou vice-prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On maomao Han Gao was exiled to Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 召右金吾將軍吳湊於延英，面授京兆尹，即令入府府視事。

translations.literal: Right Golden Guards general Wu Cou was summoned to Yanying, personally appointed Capital Metropolitan Prefect, and at once ordered to enter the prefecture and assume duties.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Cou was named metropolitan prefect at audience and sent straight to his post.

sentences.zh: 是夏，熱甚。

translations.literal: That summer was extremely hot.
translations.idiomatic: That summer was fiercely hot.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以給事中、中書門下平章事趙宗儒為太子左庶子，以左諫議大夫、平章事崔損為門下侍郎、平章事，以工部侍郎鄭餘慶為中書侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: On renshen Remonstrance Bureau attendant and Grand Secretariat Associate Zhao Zongru was made heir-apparent left senior aide; Left Remonstrance Bureau grandee and Associate Cui Sun was made Secretariat Vice Director and Associate; Works vice minister Zheng Yuqing was made Secretariat Vice Director and Concurrent Associate.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Zhao Zongru left the chancellery for the heir's staff; Cui Sun and Zheng Yuqing entered the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 左神策護軍中尉霍仙鳴卒。

translations.literal: Left Divine Strategy protector-army vice commissioner Huo Xianming died.
translations.idiomatic: Huo Xianming, protector of the Left Divine Strategy Army, died.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以宦者第五守亮代仙鳴為中尉。

translations.literal: On dingchou the eunuch Diwu Shouliang replaced Xianming as vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Diwu Shouliang became Left Divine Strategy protector.

sentences.zh: 己卯，左右神策置統軍，品秩奉給視六軍統軍例。

translations.literal: On jimao the Left and Right Divine Strategy armies established army commanders — rank, salary, and provisions following the Six Armies commanders' precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Divine Strategy armies gained commanders equal to the Six Armies.

sentences.zh: 甲午，崔損修奉八陵寢宮畢，群臣於宣政殿行稱賀。

translations.literal: On jiawu Cui Sun finished repairing the eight mausoleum palaces; the ministers performed congratulatory rites at Xuanzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the tomb repairs were finished and the court congratulated Cui Sun.

sentences.zh: 浙西觀察使、潤州刺史王緯卒。

translations.literal: Zhexi observation commissioner and Runzhou prefect Wang Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wei of Zhexi died.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未朔。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingwei new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth month opened on dingwei.

sentences.zh: 己酉，山南東道節度使、檢校尚書右僕射、襄州刺史樊澤卒。

translations.literal: On jiyou Shannan East Circuit military commissioner, acting Minister of the Right, Xiangzhou prefect Fan Ze died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Fan Ze of Shannan East died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以同州刺史崔宗為陜州大都督府長史、陜虢觀察水陸轉運使，以浙東觀察李若初為潤州刺史、浙西觀察使及諸道鹽鐵轉運使，又以常州刺史裴肅為越州刺史、浙東觀察使。

translations.literal: On maomao Tongzhou prefect Cui Zong was made chief administrator of the great metropolitan prefecture of Shanzhou, Shan-Guo observation and water-land transport commissioner; Zhedong observer Li Ruochu was made Runzhou prefect, Zhexi observer, and salt-and-iron transport commissioner for all circuits; Changzhou prefect Pei Su was made Yuezhou prefect and Zhedong observer.
translations.idiomatic: On maomao Cui Zong took Shan-Guo transport; Li Ruochu took Zhexi and salt-and-iron; Pei Su took Zhedong.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以陜虢觀察使于頔為襄州刺史、山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: On bingchen Shan-Guo observer Yu Di was made Xiangzhou prefect and Shannan East military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Yu Di became Shannan East commissioner at Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，杞王倕薨。

translations.literal: On dingmao Prince Qi Wang Chun died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Prince Qi died.

sentences.zh: 以太常卿杜確為同州刺史、本州防禦、長春宮使。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Du Que was made Tongzhou prefect, prefectural defense commissioner, and Changchun Palace commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Du Que became Tongzhou prefect and Changchun commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，諫議大夫田登奏言：「兵部武舉人持弓挾矢，數千百人入皇城，恐非所宜。

translations.literal: On guiyou Remonstrance Bureau grandee Tian Deng memorialized: "War Ministry martial-examination candidates enter the Imperial City with bows and arrows — several thousands — which is perhaps not fitting."
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Tian Deng warned that martial candidates were entering the palace armed by the thousands.

sentences.zh: 」上聞之瞿然，乃命停武舉。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard it he started; he then ordered the martial examination stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Alarmed, the emperor abolished the martial examination.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，以歲兇穀貴，擊太倉粟三十萬石，開場糶以惠民。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, guiyou: because the year was harsh and grain dear, thirty thousand shi from the great storehouse were struck out and relief markets opened to benefit the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month thirty thousand shi were sold from the granary to ease famine prices.

sentences.zh: 庚子，夏州韓全義奏破吐蕃鹽州。

translations.literal: On gengzi Xiazhou's Han Quanyi memorialized breaking Tibetans at Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Han Quanyi reported a victory over Tibet at Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，韋皋進《開西南蠻事狀》十卷，敘開復南詔之由。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiwei: Wei Gao presented ten scrolls of "Account of Opening the Southwestern Man," narrating the recovery of Nanzhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Wei Gao submitted his account of reopening Nanzhao.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，太子少師致仕郢國公韋倫卒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuzi: heir-apparent junior tutor, retired, Prince of Yingguo Wei Lun died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Wei Lun died in retirement.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，出東都含嘉倉粟七萬石，開場糶以惠河南饑民。

translations.literal: On guiyou seventy thousand shi from Luoyang's Jiahe granary were issued and relief markets opened to aid Henan famine victims.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Luoyang grain was sold to feed Henan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，南詔異牟尋遣使賀正旦。

translations.literal: On jihai Nanzhao's Yimouxun sent envoys to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Nanzhao sent New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 明州鎮將慄鍠殺刺史盧云。

translations.literal: Mingzhou garrison commander Su Huang killed prefect Lu Yun.
translations.idiomatic: Su Huang of Mingzhou murdered his prefect Lu Yun.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月丙午朔。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, spring, first month, bingwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifteenth year opened on bingwu.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，雅王逸薨。

translations.literal: On jiayin Prince Ya Wang Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Prince Ya died.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，浙西觀察使李若初卒。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Zhexi observation commissioner Li Ruochu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Ruochu died.

sentences.zh: 二月，罷中和節宴會，年兇故也。

translations.literal: Second month: the Central Harmony festival banquet was stopped — because the year was harsh.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Harmony feast was canceled for famine.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，宣武軍節度使、檢校左僕射、平章事、汴州刺史董晉卒。

translations.literal: On dingchou Xuanwu Army military commissioner, acting Minister of the Left, Associate, Bianzhou prefect Dong Jin died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Dong Jin of Bianzhou died.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以行軍司馬陸長源檢校禮部尚書、汴州刺史、御史大夫、宣武軍節度度支營田、汴宋亳潁觀察等使。

translations.literal: On yiyou campaign marshal Lu Changyuan was made acting Minister of Rites, Bianzhou prefect, censor-in-chief, Xuanwu military commissioner with revenue, garrison-farming, and Bian-Song-Bo-Ying observation powers.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Lu Changyuan was sent to command Bianzhou and the Xuanwu army.

sentences.zh: 以常州刺史李錡為潤州刺史、浙西觀察使及諸道鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: Changzhou prefect Li Qian was made Runzhou prefect, Zhexi observer, and all-circuits salt-and-iron transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qian took Zhexi and the salt-and-iron post.

sentences.zh: 是日，汴州軍亂，殺陸長源及節度判官孟叔度、丘穎，軍人臠而食之。

translations.literal: That same day Bianzhou troops mutinied, killed Lu Changyuan and military adjutants Meng Shudu and Qiu Ying, and the soldiers dismembered and ate them.
translations.idiomatic: That day Bianzhou soldiers killed Lu Changyuan and his staff and devoured the bodies.

sentences.zh: 監軍俱文珍以宋州刺史劉逸準久為汴之大將，以書招之，俾靜亂。

translations.literal: Army supervisor Ju Wenzhen, because Songzhou prefect Liu Yizhun had long been a great Bian general, wrote inviting him to quiet the disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Ju Wenzhen summoned Liu Yizhun of Songzhou to restore order.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以宋州刺史劉逸準檢校工部尚書、兼汴州刺史、宣武軍節度使，仍賜名全諒。

translations.literal: On yichou Songzhou prefect Liu Yizhun was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Bianzhou prefect and Xuanwu military commissioner, and granted the name Quanliang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Liu Yizhun became Bianzhou commissioner as Quanliang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，裴肅奏於臺州擒慄鍠以獻，斬於獨柳樹。

translations.literal: On yiwei Pei Su memorialized capturing Su Huang at Taizhou and presenting him — he was executed at Duliu Tree.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Pei Su sent Su Huang's head after capturing him at Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，罷三月群臣宴賞，歲饑也。

translations.literal: On guimao the third-month ministers' banquet reward was stopped — the year was famished.
translations.idiomatic: The spring court banquet was canceled for hunger.

sentences.zh: 出太倉粟十八萬石，糶於京畿諸縣。

translations.literal: One hundred eighty thousand shi from the great storehouse were sold in the capital districts.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred eighty thousand shi were sold around the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，吳少誠寇唐州，殺監軍邵國朝，掠居民千餘而去。

translations.literal: Third month, jiayin: Wu Shaocheng raided Tang Prefecture, killed army supervisor Shao Guochao, and carried off more than a thousand civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Wu Shaocheng raided Tangzhou, killed the supervisor, and abducted civilians.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以度支郎中、兼中丞於䪹為戶部侍郎，依前判度支。

translations.literal: On dingsi Revenue section chief and concurrent vice censor-in-chief Yu Mian was made Revenue vice minister, still acting transport controller.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Yu Mian became revenue vice minister while keeping transport duties.

sentences.zh: 戊午，昭義軍節度使、檢校工部尚書王虔休卒。

translations.literal: On wuwu Zhaoyi Army military commissioner, acting Minister of Works Wang Qianxiu died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Wang Qianxiu of Zhaoyi died.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以河陽三城節度使李元為潞州長史、昭義軍節度、澤潞磁邢洺觀察使，以河陽節度押衙衡濟為懷州刺史、河陽三城懷州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen Heyang Three Cities military commissioner Li Yuan was made chief administrator of Luzhou, Zhaoyi military commissioner, and Ze-Lu-Ci-Xing-Ming observer; Heyang military adjutant Heng Ji was made Huaizhou prefect and Heyang Three Cities Huai military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Li Yuan took Zhaoyi; Heng Ji took Heyang-Huai.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太子少師致仕於頎卒。

translations.literal: On xinwei retired heir-apparent junior tutor Yu Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Yu Yi died in retirement.

sentences.zh: 壬申，於易州滿城縣置永清軍。

translations.literal: On renshen the Yongqing Army was established at Mancheng County in Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Yongqing Army was founded at Mancheng.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，令江淮歲運米二百萬石。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Jiang-Huai circuits were ordered to transport two million shi of grain yearly.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the court ordered two million shi of Jiang-Huai grain shipped annually.

sentences.zh: 雖有是命，然歲運不過四十萬石。

translations.literal: Though the order stood, yearly transport did not exceed four hundred thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: In practice only four hundred thousand shi moved each year.

sentences.zh: 四月丁丑，以久旱，令陰陽人法術祈雨。

translations.literal: Fourth month, dingchou: because of long drought, yin-yang specialists were ordered to perform rain rites by law and technique.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou rain rites were ordered after prolonged drought.

sentences.zh: 壬午，內侍省加置內給事二員。

translations.literal: On renwu two additional inner provisioners were added to the Palace Domestic Service.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the inner palace gained two provisioners.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以安州刺史伊慎為安黃節度營田觀察使。

translations.literal: On guiwei Anzhou prefect Yi Shen was made An-Huang military, garrison-farming, and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Yi Shen became An-Huang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，應京城內外諸軍縣鎮職員官，見共五萬八千二百七十一人，宜令每人賜粟一石。

translations.literal: On gengyin all military, county, and garrison staff inside and outside the capital — in all 58,271 persons — were each to be granted one shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin every capital soldier and clerk received one shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 乙未，特進、兵部尚書歸崇敬卒。

translations.literal: On yiwei Special Advance, Minister of War Gui Chongjing died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Gui Chongjing died.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰朔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiachen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month opened on jiachen.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，宗正卿嗣吳王巘薨。

translations.literal: On wuchen Court of Imperial Sacrifices director, collateral Prince of Wu Wu Zhan died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Prince of Wu Wu Zhan died.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，黔中觀察使、御史中丞王礎卒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jimao: Qianzhong observation commissioner and vice censor-in-chief Wang Chu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Wang Chu died.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，山南西道節度使、檢校尚書左僕射、平章事嚴震卒。

translations.literal: On guisi Shannan West Circuit military commissioner, acting Minister of the Left, Associate Yan Zhen died.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Yan Zhen of Shannan West died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，以興州刺史、興元都虞候嚴礪為興元尹、兼御史大夫、山南西道節度度支營田觀察等使。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, yisi: Xingzhou prefect and Xingyuan chief of staff Yan Li was made Xingyuan prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, Shannan West military, revenue, garrison-farming, and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Yan Li became Shannan West commissioner at Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，故唐安公主賜謚曰莊穆。

translations.literal: On bingwu the late Princess Tang'an was granted the posthumous title Zhuangmu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Princess Tang'an received the posthumous title Zhuangmu.

sentences.zh: 公主賜謚，自唐安始也。

translations.literal: Posthumous titles for princesses began with Tang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial princesses first received posthumous titles with Tang'an.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以王礎卒，廢朝一日。

translations.literal: On dingwei because Wang Chu died, court was suspended one day.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei court was canceled for Wang Chu's death.

sentences.zh: 觀察使卒廢朝，自礎始也。

translations.literal: Suspending court when an observation commissioner died began with Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Canceling court for an observer's death began with Chu.

sentences.zh: 戊午，貶諫議大夫苗拯萬州刺史，左拾遺李繁播州參軍，以私議除拜嚴礪不當而無章疏，而偽言累上疏故也。

translations.literal: On wuwu Remonstrance Bureau grandee Miao Zheng was demoted to Wanzhou prefect; Left Collector Li Fan to Bozhou army adjutant — for privately debating Yan Li's improper appointment without memorial, yet falsely claiming repeated submissions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Miao Zheng and Li Fan were exiled for gossiping about Yan Li's appointment instead of memorializing.

sentences.zh: 鄭、滑大水。

translations.literal: Zheng and Hua suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng and Hua circuits flooded.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申朔。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renshen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month opened on renshen.

sentences.zh: 丙申，陳許節度使、檢校尚書右僕射、許州刺史曲環卒。

translations.literal: On bingshen Chen-Xu military commissioner, acting Minister of the Right, Xuzhou prefect Qu Huan died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Qu Huan of Chen-Xu died.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以洋州刺史韋士宗為黔中觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingyou Yangzhou prefect Wei Shizong was made Qianzhong observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Wei Shizong became Qianzhong observer.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以陳許兵馬使、前陳州刺史上官涚為許州刺史、陳許節度使。

translations.literal: On bingwu Chen-Xu army marshal and former Chenzhou prefect Shangguan Shui was made Xuzhou prefect and Chen-Xu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Shangguan Shui took Chen-Xu at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 吳少誠謀逆漸甚，陷臨潁，進圍許州。

translations.literal: Wu Shaocheng's plotting of rebellion grew daily; he seized Linying and pressed the siege of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shaocheng's revolt deepened: he took Linying and besieged Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，宣武軍節度使、檢校工部尚書、汴州刺史劉全諒卒。

translations.literal: On gengxu Xuanwu military commissioner, acting Minister of Works, Bianzhou prefect Liu Quanliang died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Liu Quanliang of Bianzhou died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，年：「吳少誠非次擢用，授以節旄，秩居端揆之榮，任總列城之重。

translations.literal: On bingchen an edict stated: "Wu Shaocheng was promoted out of turn, given a command banner, rank standing with the highest ministers, responsibility over many cities.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict declared: "Wu Shaocheng was raised beyond merit and given a full command.

sentences.zh: 期申報效，奉我典章，而秉心匪彞，自底不類。

translations.literal: We expected repayment of service and obedience to our statutes; yet he harbors a heart not constant and brings himself to ruin.
translations.idiomatic: We expected loyalty to law; instead his heart turned treacherous.

sentences.zh: 兇狡成性，扇構多端，擅動甲兵，暴越封圵。

translations.literal: Ferocity and cunning are his nature; he stirs many plots, moves troops on his own, and violently crosses the border markers.
translations.idiomatic: He is cruel and cunning, raises armies without warrant, and tramples the frontier.

sentences.zh: 壽州茶園，輒縱凌奪；

translations.literal: At Shouzhou's tea gardens he wantonly plundered;
translations.idiomatic: He looted Shouzhou's tea estates;

sentences.zh: 唐州詔使，潛構殺傷。

translations.literal: at Tangzhou he secretly engineered the killing of an imperial envoy.
translations.idiomatic: and at Tangzhou he had an imperial envoy murdered.

sentences.zh: 干犯國章，罪在無赦。

translations.literal: He violated the statutes of the state — his crime admits no pardon.
translations.idiomatic: His crimes are beyond pardon.

sentences.zh: 朕以王者之德，在乎好生；

translations.literal: We, in the virtue of a king, value sparing life;
translations.idiomatic: A king's virtue is to spare life;

sentences.zh: 人君之體，務於含垢。

translations.literal: the body of a ruler must bear stain and endure offense.
translations.idiomatic: a ruler must sometimes swallow insult.

sentences.zh: 寧屈已以宥罪，不殘人以興師。

translations.literal: We would rather humble Ourselves to forgive crime than destroy men to raise armies.
translations.idiomatic: We chose mercy over marching armies against him.

sentences.zh: 以上稽宗社之威，外抑忠賢之請，庶有悛革，尚議優容。

translations.literal: Above We weighed the majesty of the altars; below We restrained the loyal and worthy from pleading — hoping for repentance, still debating leniency.
translations.idiomatic: We bowed to state majesty and silenced loyal ministers, still hoping he would repent.

sentences.zh: 幸鄰境之喪，逞貪亂之志，焚略縣邑，殘暴吾民。

translations.literal: He took advantage of a neighbor's mourning to display greedy disorder, burning and plundering counties, brutalizing Our people.
translations.idiomatic: When a neighbor mourned he burned counties and brutalized our people.

sentences.zh: 朕尤冀知非，為之忍恥，及頒恩命，未許出師。

translations.literal: We still hoped he would know his fault and bear the shame; when We issued gracious orders We still did not permit armies to march.
translations.idiomatic: We bore the shame and withheld troops even after gracious edicts.

sentences.zh: 至乃攻逼許州，肆其蠆毒，恣行殺戮，流害黎蒸。

translations.literal: Then he pressed the attack on Xuzhou, unleashed his poison, wantonly killed, and spread harm among the common folk.
translations.idiomatic: Then he besieged Xuzhou, slaughtered, and poisoned the land.

sentences.zh: 惡稔禍盈，人神同棄。

translations.literal: Evil ripe, calamity full — men and spirits alike cast him off.
translations.idiomatic: His wickedness filled heaven and earth; gods and men abandoned him.

sentences.zh: 興言致討，實悼于懷。

translations.literal: To speak of raising punishment truly grieves Our heart.
translations.idiomatic: To punish him now grieves Us — yet We must.

sentences.zh: 宜令諸道各出師徒，掎角齊進。

translations.literal: Let every circuit send troops, advance together in pincer.
translations.idiomatic: Let every circuit march and strike together.

sentences.zh: 吳少誠在身官爵，並宜削奪。

translations.literal: Wu Shaocheng's offices and titles while living are all to be stripped."
translations.idiomatic: Strip Wu Shaocheng of every rank and office."

sentences.zh: 」己巳，自今中和、重陽二節，每節只禁屠一日。

translations.literal: On jisi from now on, at the Central Harmony and Double Ninth festivals, each festival shall forbid slaughter for one day only.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi slaughter was banned for one day at each of the two festivals.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以大理評事宣武軍都知兵馬使韓弘檢校工部尚書，兼汴州刺史、御史大夫、宣武軍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinyou Grand Court reviewer and Xuanwu army marshal Han Hong was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Bianzhou prefect, censor-in-chief, and Xuanwu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Han Hong became Bianzhou and Xuanwu commander.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己丑，邕王謜薨。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jichou: Prince Yong Wang Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Prince Yong died.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎奚陟卒。

translations.literal: Personnel vice minister Xi Zhi died.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Zhi of the Board of Personnel died.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，冬至，罷朝會，兵興也。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yisi: winter solstice — court assembly was stopped; armies were active.
translations.idiomatic: Court was canceled on the solstice because of war.

sentences.zh: 壬子，襄州于頔奏，於朗山破淮西賊三千人。

translations.literal: On renzi Xiangzhou's Yu Di memorialized breaking three thousand Huai-Xi rebels at Langshan.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yu Di reported killing three thousand rebels at Langshan.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，朔方等道副元帥、河中絳州節度使、檢校司徒、兼奉朔中書令渾瑊薨。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengwu: deputy commander-in-chief of Shuofang and other circuits, Hezhong-Jiang military commissioner, acting Minister of Works, concurrent Shuofang director and Secretariat Director Hun Jian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Hun Jian died.

sentences.zh: 乙未，戰淮西賊於小溵河，王師不利，諸軍自潰。

translations.literal: On yiwei the army fought Huai-Xi rebels at the Little Yin River; the imperial forces were unfavorable and the armies scattered on their own.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the imperial army was routed at the Little Yin River.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以同州刺史杜確為河中尹、河中絳州觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingyou Tongzhou prefect Du Que was made Hezhong prefect and Hezhong-Jiang observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Du Que became Hezhong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月庚子朔。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, spring, first month, gengzi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The sixteenth year opened on gengzi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，恆冀、定州、許、河陽四鎮之師與賊戰，皆不利而退。

translations.literal: On yisi the armies of Heng-Ji, Ding, Xu, and Heyang fought the rebels — all were unfavorable and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi four provincial armies attacked and were beaten back.

sentences.zh: 南詔獻《奉聖樂舞曲》，上閱於麟德殿前。

translations.literal: Nanzhao presented the "Offering Sacred Music" dance suite; the emperor viewed it before Lindé Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Nanzhao sent a dance suite performed before Lindé Hall.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，以左神策行營、銀夏節度等使韓全義為蔡州行營招討使，陳許節度使上官涚副之。

translations.literal: Second month, jiyou: Left Divine Strategy campaign and Yin-Xia military commissioner Han Quanyi was made Caizhou campaign commander-in-chief; Chen-Xu commissioner Shangguan Shui was his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Han Quanyi commanded the Cai campaign with Shangguan Shui as deputy.

sentences.zh: 己丑，左龍武統軍程懷直卒。

translations.literal: On jichou Left Dragon Martial commanding general Cheng Huaizhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Cheng Huaizhi died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，華州刺史、潼關防禦、鎮國軍使盧征卒。

translations.literal: On jiyou Huazhou prefect, Tongguan defense commissioner, and Zhenguo Army commissioner Lu Zheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Lu Zheng of Huazhou died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以尚書右丞袁滋為華州刺史、潼關防禦、鎮國軍使。

translations.literal: On renzi Minister of the Right assistant Yuan Zi was made Huazhou prefect, Tongguan defense commissioner, and Zhenguo Army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yuan Zi took Huazhou and Tongguan defense.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，黔中知宴設吏傅近逐觀察使韋士宗。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, dinghai: Qianzhong banquet-setup clerk Fu Jin drove out observation commissioner Wei Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Fu Jin expelled Wei Shizong from Qianzhong.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以義成軍節度使姚南仲為右僕射。

translations.literal: On jichou Yicheng Army military commissioner Yao Nanzhong was made Minister of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Yao Nanzhong became minister of the right.

sentences.zh: 以權知新羅國事金俊邕襲祖開府檢校太尉、雞林州都督、新羅國王。

translations.literal: Kim Junyong, acting ruler of Silla, inherited his grandfather's offices of Kaifu, acting Grand Preceptor, Silla prefect, and King of Silla.
translations.idiomatic: Silla's regent Kim Junyong received his grandfather's titles and the Silla kingship.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以義成軍行軍司馬盧群為滑州刺史、兼御史中丞、義成軍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinmao Yicheng campaign marshal Lu Qun was made Huazhou prefect, concurrent vice censor-in-chief, and Yicheng military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Lu Qun became Huazhou and Yicheng commander.

sentences.zh: 壬申，檢校兵部尚書、京兆尹吳湊卒。

translations.literal: On renshen acting Minister of War and Capital Metropolitan Prefect Wu Cou died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wu Cou died.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌朔，以雨罷朝。
