translations.literal: Fifth month, wuxu new moon: because of rain, court was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Rain canceled court on the fifth month's new moon.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，韓全義與蔡賊將吳少誠戰于溵水南，王師敗績。

translations.literal: On gengxu Han Quanyi fought Cai rebel general Wu Shaocheng south of the Yin River; the imperial army suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Han Quanyi was crushed south of the Yin River.

sentences.zh: 徐泗濠節度使、檢校尚書右僕射、徐州刺史張建封卒。

translations.literal: Xu-Si-Hao military commissioner, acting Minister of the Right, Xuzhou prefect Zhang Jianfeng died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jianfeng of Xu-Si died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，徐州軍亂，不納行軍司馬韋夏卿，迫建封子愔為留後。

translations.literal: On renzi Xuzhou troops mutinied, would not accept campaign marshal Wei Xiaqing, and forced Jianfeng's son Yin as acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Xuzhou soldiers rejected Wei Xiaqing and installed Zhang Yin as acting chief.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，韋士宗卻入黔州。

translations.literal: On bingyin Wei Shizong returned to Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Wei Shizong re-entered Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以吏部侍郎顧少連為京兆尹。

translations.literal: On dingmao Personnel vice minister Gu Shaolian was made Capital Metropolitan Prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Gu Shaolian became metropolitan prefect.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，鄆州李師古、淮南杜祐並加同平章事，以祐兼領徐、泗、濠節度，以前虢州參軍張愔起復驍衛將軍，兼徐州刺史、御史中丞、本州團練使、知徐州留後。

translations.literal: Sixth month, bingwu: Yanzhou's Li Shigu and Huainan's Du You were both made Concurrent Associates; You also took Xu-Si-Hao; former Guozhou aide Zhang Yin was recalled to Rapid Guard general, concurrent Xuzhou prefect, censor-in-chief, prefectural regimental commissioner, and acting Xuzhou chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Li Shigu and Du You entered the chancellery; Du You also took Xu-Si-Hao while Zhang Yin held Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，湖南觀察使呂渭卒。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Hunan observation commissioner Lü Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Lü Wei of Hunan died.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉，以河中尹王囗為潭州刺史、湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, guiyou: Hezhong prefect Wang [character missing in text] was made Tanzhou prefect and Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the Hezhong prefect Wang Shao became Hunan commissioner at Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，宥吳少誠。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Wu Shaocheng was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Wu Shaocheng was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 駙馬都尉郭曖卒。

translations.literal: Emperor's son-in-law Guo Ai died.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ai, imperial son-in-law, died.

sentences.zh: 義成軍節度使盧群卒。

translations.literal: Yicheng Army military commissioner Lu Qun died.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Qun of Yicheng died.

sentences.zh: 丙午，前太常卿裴鬱卒。

translations.literal: On bingwu former Minister of Rites Pei Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Pei Yu died.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以左丞李元素為滑州刺史、兼御史大夫、義成軍節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen Left Assistant Li Yuansu was made Huazhou prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Yicheng military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Li Yuansu took Yicheng at Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，貶中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事鄭餘慶為郴州司馬，戶部侍郎、判度支於䪹為泉州司戶。

translations.literal: On gengxu Secretariat Vice Director and Concurrent Associate Zheng Yuqing was demoted to Chenzhou vice-prefect; Revenue vice minister and transport controller Yu Mian to Quanzhou registrar.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zheng Yuqing and Yu Mian were exiled to the south.

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎王紹判度支，以戶閱郎中崔從質為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Revenue vice minister Wang Shao was made acting transport controller; Revenue section chief Cui Congzhi was made Revenue vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shao took transport; Cui Congzhi became revenue vice minister.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，吳少誠賊迫官軍溵水砦下營，韓全義退保陳州，諸軍散還本道，官軍不振。

translations.literal: On guiyou Wu Shaocheng's rebels pressed the imperial army's camp below the Yin River fort; Han Quanyi withdrew to defend Chenzhou; the armies scattered to their circuits — the imperial forces did not recover.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the campaign collapsed: Han Quanyi fled to Chenzhou and the armies dispersed.

sentences.zh: 以河南少尹張式為河南尹、水陸轉運使。

translations.literal: Henan assistant metropolitan prefect Zhang Shi was made Henan metropolitan prefect and water-land transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shi became Henan prefect and transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以太常卿齊抗為中書侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: On gengshen Minister of Rites Qi Kang was made Secretariat Vice Director and Concurrent Associate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Qi Kang entered the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以虔王諒為徐州節度使，張愔為留後。

translations.literal: On guihai Prince Qian Wang Liang was made Xuzhou military commissioner; Zhang Yin was acting chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Prince Qian took Xuzhou; Zhang Yin remained acting chief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，興元嚴礪希監軍旨，誣奏流人通州別駕崔河圖，長流崖州，賜死，人士傷之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, xinwei: Xingyuan's Yan Li, courting the army supervisor's intent, falsely memorialized exiled Tongzhou vice-prefect Cui Hetu, sentenced him to distant exile at Yazhou, and granted death — scholars grieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Yan Li had the exile Cui Hetu executed at Yazhou to please the supervisor.

sentences.zh: 吳少誠引兵歸蔡州，上表待罪。

translations.literal: Wu Shaocheng led troops back to Caizhou and submitted a table awaiting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shaocheng returned to Caizhou and submitted a confession.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔雪吳少誠，復其官爵。

translations.literal: On wuzi an edict cleared Wu Shaocheng and restored his offices and titles.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Wu Shaocheng was pardoned and restored to rank.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，河東節度使、檢校禮部尚書、太原尹、兼御史大夫、北都留守李悅卒。

translations.literal: On yichou Hedong military commissioner, acting Minister of Rites, Taiyuan prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, northern capital protector Li Yue died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Li Yue of Hedong died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以河東行軍司馬鄭儋檢校工部尚書、太原尹、河東節度使。

translations.literal: On jiawu Hedong campaign marshal Zheng Dan was made acting Minister of Works, Taiyuan prefect, and Hedong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zheng Dan became Hedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，泗州、濠州宜隸淮南觀察使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guimao: Sizhou and Haozhou were to be subordinate to the Huainan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Sizhou and Haozhou were placed under Huainan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以太府卿韋渠牟為太常寺卿。

translations.literal: On wushen Grand Steward Wei Qumou was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Wei Qumou became minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，罷吏部復考判官及禮部別頭貢舉。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuyin: Personnel re-examination judges and the Ministry of Rites' separate-head examination were stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month certain examination posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月甲午朔。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year, spring, first month, jiawu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The seventeenth year opened on jiawu.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，韓全義自蔡州行營還，詔歸鎮華州。

translations.literal: On jiayin Han Quanyi returned from the Caizhou campaign headquarters; an edict ordered him back to his post at Hua.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Han Quanyi left the front for Hua.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳朔，賜群臣宴於曲江亭，上賦《中和節賜宴曲江詩》六韻賜之。

translations.literal: Second month, guisi new moon: ministers were feasted at Qujiang Pavilion; the emperor composed a six-rhyme "Central Harmony Festival Banquet at Qujiang" and bestowed it.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month's new moon the court feasted at Qujiang with a six-line imperial poem.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，雨雹。

translations.literal: On dingyou hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: Hail struck on dingyou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，雨霜。

translations.literal: On jihai frost fell.
translations.idiomatic: Frost fell on jihai.

sentences.zh: 戊申夜，雷震，雨雹。

translations.literal: On wushen night thunder sounded and hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen night thunder brought hail.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大雨兼雹。

translations.literal: On gengxu great rain mixed with hail.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu heavy rain and hail struck.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，賜群臣宴於曲江亭。

translations.literal: Third month, yichou: ministers were feasted at Qujiang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou another Qujiang feast was held.

sentences.zh: 己巳，黔中觀察使韋士宗復為三軍所逐。

translations.literal: On jisi Qianzhong observation commissioner Wei Shizong was again driven out by the three armies.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Wei Shizong was expelled from Qianzhong again.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，衢州刺史鄭式瞻進絹五千匹，銀二千兩，上曰：「式瞻犯贓，已詔御史按問，所進宜付左藏庫。

translations.literal: On guiyou Quzhou prefect Zheng Shizhan presented five thousand bolts of silk and two thousand taels of silver; the emperor said: "Shizhan is guilty of corruption — the censorate has already been ordered to investigate; what he presents should go to the Left Treasury."
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Zheng Shizhan's bribe was sent to the treasury while he was under investigation.

sentences.zh: 」丁丑，省天下州府別駕、司馬、田曹、參軍；

translations.literal: On dingchou vice-prefects, vice-marshals, field-office officers, and adjutants were cut throughout the empire;
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou many prefectural posts were abolished empire-wide;

sentences.zh: 京兆、河南、太原三府外，諸府判司雙曹者省一。

translations.literal: apart from the three metropolitan prefectures, where two clerks had held a post, one was cut.
translations.idiomatic: outside the three capitals, duplicate prefectural clerks were halved.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，始命駙馬及郡縣主婿無子者，養男不用母廕。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, dingwei: from now, imperial sons-in-law and commandery princesses' husbands without sons might adopt sons without using the mother's privilege.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei childless imperial sons-in-law and princesses' husbands could adopt heirs without maternal privilege.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以諫議大夫裴佶為黔中觀察使。

translations.literal: On xinhai Remonstrance Bureau grandee Pei Ji was made Qianzhong observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Pei Ji became Qianzhong observer.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renxu new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth month's new moon the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，邠寧節度使、檢校工部尚書、邠州刺史楊朝晟卒。

translations.literal: On yiyou Binning military commissioner, acting Minister of Works, Bin prefect Yang Zhaosheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Yang Zhaosheng of Binning died.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以工部侍郎趙植為廣州刺史、兼御史大夫、嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: On bingxu Works vice minister Zhao Zhi was made Guangzhou prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Lingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zhao Zhi became Lingnan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，以定平鎮兵馬使李朝寀校工部尚書，兼邠州刺史、朔方邠寧慶節度使；

translations.literal: Sixth month, wuxu: Dingping garrison marshal Li Chaocai was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Bin prefect and Shuofang-Binning-Qing military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Li Chaocai took Binning;

sentences.zh: 以中官楊志廉為右神策護軍中尉。

translations.literal: the eunuch Yang Zhiliang was made Right Divine Strategy protector-army vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: and Yang Zhiliang became Right Divine Strategy protector.

sentences.zh: 浙西人崔善真詣闕上書，論浙西觀察使李錡罪狀。

translations.literal: A man of Zhexi, Cui Shanzhen, came to the palace gate and submitted a memorial on the crimes of Zhexi observation commissioner Li Qian.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Shanzhen of Zhexi memorialized against Li Qian at the gate.

sentences.zh: 上覽奏不悅，令械善真送於李錡。

translations.literal: When the emperor read the memorial he was displeased and ordered Shanzhen shackled and sent to Li Qian.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, angered, sent Shanzhen in chains to Li Qian.

sentences.zh: 為鑿坑待善真，既至，和械推而埋之。

translations.literal: A pit was dug to await him; when he arrived, still in fetters he was pushed in and buried.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qian buried him alive in a prepared pit.

sentences.zh: 由是錡恣橫叛。

translations.literal: From this Qian grew reckless and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Li Qian turned openly rebellious.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以邠寧兵馬使高固為邠州刺史、兼御史大夫、邠寧慶節度使。

translations.literal: On jiyou Binning army marshal Gao Gu was made Bin prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Binning-Qing military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Gao Gu became Binning commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，成德軍節度使、恆冀深趙德棣觀察等使、恆州大都督府長史、檢校太尉、中書令、瑯邪郡王王武俊薨，贈太師，謚曰忠烈。

translations.literal: On dingsi Chengde Army military commissioner, Heng-Ji-Shen-Zhao Dede observation commissioner, chief administrator of the great metropolitan prefecture of Hengzhou, acting Grand Preceptor, Secretariat Director, Prince of Langye Wang Wujun died — posthumously made Grand Preceptor, posthumous title Zhonglie.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Wang Wujun died and was posthumously enfeoffed as grand preceptor with the title Zhonglie.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，吐蕃寇鹽州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuyin: Tibet raided Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Tibet raided Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以前成德軍節度副使、檢校工部尚書、知恆府事、清河郡王王士真起復授恆州長史，充成德軍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinsi former Chengde deputy military commissioner, acting Minister of Works, acting Heng prefect, Prince of Qinghe Wang Shizhen was recalled to service and made chief administrator of Hengzhou, filling the Chengde military commission.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Wang Shizhen succeeded his father at Chengde.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太常卿韋渠牟卒。

translations.literal: On yiyou Minister of Rites Wei Qumou died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Wei Qumou died.

sentences.zh: 己丑，吐蕃陷麟州，殺刺史郭鋒，毀城壘而去。

translations.literal: On jichou Tibet took Lin Prefecture, killed prefect Guo Feng, destroyed walls and ramparts, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Tibet sacked Linzhou, killed Guo Feng, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，以河東行軍司馬嚴綬檢校工部尚書、兼太原尹、御史大夫、河東節度使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuwu: Hedong campaign marshal Yan Sui was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Taiyuan prefect, censor-in-chief, and Hedong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Yan Sui became Hedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，韋皋奏大破吐蕃於雅州。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renxu: Wei Gao memorialized a great defeat of Tibet at Yazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Wei Gao reported crushing Tibet at Yazhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，群臣宴曲江，上賦《九日賜宴曲江亭詩》六韻賜之。

translations.literal: On wuchen ministers banqueted at Qujiang; the emperor composed a six-rhyme "Ninth Day Banquet at Qujiang Pavilion" and bestowed it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the court feasted at Qujiang with a six-line Ninth Day poem.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，禮部尚書李齊運卒。

translations.literal: On dingchou Minister of Rites Li Qiyun died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Qiyun died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，加韋皋檢校司徒、中書令，封南康郡王，賞破吐蕃功也。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Wei Gao was advanced to acting Minister of Works, Secretariat Director, enfeoffed Prince of Nankang commandery — rewarding the defeat of Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Wei Gao was made prince of Nankang for defeating Tibet.

sentences.zh: 戊午，鹽州刺史杜彥先委城奔慶州。

translations.literal: On wuwu Yan Prefecture prefect Du Yanzian abandoned the city and fled to Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Yanzhou's Du Yanzian fled to Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，宰相賈耽上《海內華夷圖》及《古今郡國縣道四夷述》四十卷。

translations.literal: On xinwei Chancellor Jia Dan presented the "Map of Chinese and Barbarians Within the Seas" and "Account of Ancient and Modern Commanderies, Counties, Roads, and the Four Barbarians" in forty scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Jia Dan submitted his atlas and geography in forty scrolls.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，翰林侍詔戴少平死十六日復生。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Hanlin attendant drafter Dai Shaoping died sixteen days and came back to life.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Dai Shaoping revived after sixteen days dead.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以京兆尹顧少連為吏部尚書，以吏部侍郎韋夏卿為京兆尹。

translations.literal: On gengxu Capital Metropolitan Prefect Gu Shaolian was made Minister of Personnel; Personnel vice minister Wei Xiaqing was made Capital Metropolitan Prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Gu Shaolian and Wei Xiaqing exchanged the capital and personnel posts.

sentences.zh: 淮南節度使杜祐進《通典》，凡九門，共二百卷。

translations.literal: Huainan military commissioner Du You presented the "Comprehensive Institutions," nine sections in two hundred scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: Du You of Huainan presented his Comprehensive Institutions in two hundred scrolls.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月戊午朔，大雨雪，罷朝賀。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year, spring, first month, wuwu new moon: great rain and snow — court congratulations were stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Snow canceled New Year court in the eighteenth year.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，驃國王遣使悉利移來朝貢，並獻其國樂十二曲與樂工三十五人。

translations.literal: On yichou the Pyu king sent the envoy Xilijiao to court with tribute, also presenting twelve tunes of his state's music and thirty-five musicians.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Pyu envoys brought music and musicians.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，韋皋以所擒蕃相論莽熱來獻。

translations.literal: On yihai Wei Gao presented the captured Tibetan minister Lun Mangre.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Wei Gao sent the Tibetan minister Lun Mangre as a captive.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以常州刺史賈全為越州刺史、浙東觀察使。

translations.literal: On gengchen Changzhou prefect Jia Quan was made Yuezhou prefect and Zhedong observer.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Jia Quan became Zhedong observer.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子朔，賜群臣宴於馬璘之山池。

translations.literal: Second month, wuzi new moon: ministers were feasted at Ma Lin's mountain pool.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month's new moon the court banqueted at Ma Lin's estate.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，以劍南東川行軍司馬李康為梓州刺史、兼御史大夫、劍南東川節度使。

translations.literal: Third month, guiwei: Jiannan East campaign marshal Li Kang was made Zizhou prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Jiannan East military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Li Kang took Jiannan East at Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜群臣宴於馬璘之山池。

translations.literal: On yichou ministers were feasted at Ma Lin's mountain pool.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou another feast was held at Ma Lin's pool.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以蘄州刺史鄭紳為鄂州刺史、鄂岳蘄沔觀察使。

translations.literal: On jisi Qizhou prefect Zheng Shen was made Ezhou prefect and E-Yue-Qi-Mian observer.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zheng Shen became E-Yue-Qi-Mian commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以浙東團練副使齊總為衢州刺史，總以橫賦進奉希恩，給事中許孟容封還制書。

translations.literal: On guiyou Zhedong regimental vice commissioner Qi Zong was made Quzhou prefect; Zong advanced excessive levies as tribute seeking favor — Remonstrance Bureau attendant Xu Mengrong returned the sealed edict.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Qi Zong's appointment was blocked after Xu Mengrong returned the edict over his levies.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以河中行軍司馬鄭元為河中尹、兼御史大夫、河中絳節度使。

translations.literal: On bingxu Hedong campaign marshal Zheng Yuan was made Hezhong prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Hezhong-Jiang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zheng Yuan became Hezhong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，以竇群為左拾遺。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guihai: Dou Qun was made Left Collector.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Dou Qun became a left collector.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以祠部員外郎裴泰為檢校兵部郎中，充安南都護、本管經略使。

translations.literal: On gengchen Sacrifices Bureau outer-section chief Pei Tai was made acting War Bureau chief, Annan protector, and circuit pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Pei Tai was sent to Annan as protector.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，以吏部尚書顧少連為兵部尚書、東都留守、東都畿汝防禦使。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guisi: Minister of Personnel Gu Shaolian was made Minister of War, Luoyang protector, and eastern capital Ji-Ru defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Gu Shaolian became Luoyang protector.

sentences.zh: 前東都留守、檢校禮部尚書王翃卒。

translations.literal: Former Luoyang protector, acting Minister of Rites Wang Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hong, former Luoyang protector, died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，蔡、申、光三州春水夏旱，賜帛五萬段，米十萬石，鹽三千石。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengchen: Cai, Shen, and Guang circuits had spring floods and summer drought — fifty thousand bolts of silk, one hundred thousand shi of grain, and three thousand shi of salt were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Cai, Shen, and Guang received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，以邕管經略使徐申為廣州刺史、嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renyin: Yongguan pacification commissioner Xu Shen was made Guangzhou prefect and Lingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Xu Shen became Lingnan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以嶺南節度掌書記、試大理評事張正元為邕州刺史、御史中丞、邕管經略使，給事中許孟容以非次遷授，封還詔書。

translations.literal: On jiachen Lingnan military recorder, trial Grand Court reviewer Zhang Zhengyuan was made Yongzhou prefect, vice censor-in-chief, and Yongguan pacification commissioner; Remonstrance Bureau attendant Xu Mengrong, because the appointment was out of turn, returned the sealed edict.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhang Zhengyuan's Yongguan post was returned by Xu Mengrong as irregular.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以戶部侍郎、判度支王紹為戶部尚書、判度支。

translations.literal: On dingwei Revenue vice minister and transport controller Wang Shao was made Minister of Revenue, still acting transport controller.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Wang Shao became revenue minister while keeping transport.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯朔，以太常少卿楊憑為潭州刺史、湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yimao new moon: Minister of Rites junior vice director Yang Ping was made Tanzhou prefect and Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth month's new moon Yang Ping became Hunan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 賜群臣宴於馬璘山池，上賦《九日賜宴詩》六韻賜之。

translations.literal: Ministers were feasted at Ma Lin's mountain pool; the emperor composed a six-rhyme "Ninth Day Banquet" and bestowed it.
translations.idiomatic: The court feasted at Ma Lin's pool with a six-line Ninth Day poem.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，以刑部尚書王鍔為淮南節度副使兼行軍司馬。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dinghai: Minister of Punishments Wang E was made Huainan deputy military commissioner and campaign marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Wang E became Huainan deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 己酉，鄜坊丹延節度使、檢校禮部尚書王棲耀卒。

translations.literal: On jiyou Yan-Fang-Dan-Yan military commissioner, acting Minister of Rites Wang Qiyao died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Wang Qiyao of Yan-Fang died.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，以同州刺史劉公濟為鄜州刺史、鄜坊丹延節度使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, bingchen: Tongzhou prefect Liu Gongji was made Yan prefect and Yan-Fang-Dan-Yan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Liu Gongji became Yan-Fang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，貶大理卿李正臣為衛尉少卿，正臣為御史彈劾下獄，不堪其辱而死。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yisi: Grand Court director Li Zhengchen was demoted to Court of the Imperial Stud junior director — Zhengchen had been impeached by the censorate and imprisoned; unable to bear the shame he died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Li Zhengchen died after demotion and imprisonment.

sentences.zh: 戊申，黎州蠻、牂柯使入朝。

translations.literal: On wushen envoys from Lizhou Man and Zangke came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen frontier envoys from Lizhou and Zangke arrived.

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月癸丑朔。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year, spring, first month, guichou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The nineteenth year opened on guichou.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午朔，賜宴馬璘山池。

translations.literal: Second month, renwu new moon: a banquet at Ma Lin's mountain pool.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the court feasted at Ma Lin's pool.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，修含元殿。

translations.literal: On dinghai Hanyuan Hall was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Hanyuan Hall was restored.

sentences.zh: 賜安黃節度曰奉義軍。

translations.literal: The An-Huang command was named the Fengyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: An-Huang was renamed the Fengyi Army.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以桂管留後韋武為桂州刺史、桂管觀察使。

translations.literal: On bingshen Gui circuit acting chief Wei Wu was made Guizhou prefect and Gui observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wei Wu became Gui commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己亥，安南經略使裴泰為州將王季元所逐。

translations.literal: On jihai Annan pacification commissioner Pei Tai was driven out by prefectural general Wang Jiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Pei Tai was expelled from Annan by Wang Jiyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，淮南節度使杜祐來朝。

translations.literal: On jiachen Huainan military commissioner Du You came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Du You of Huainan came to audience.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子朔，以杜祐檢校司空、同中書門下平章事、太清宮使。

translations.literal: Third month, renzi new moon: Du You was made acting Minister of Works, Concurrent Associate, and Grand Pure Palace commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the third month's new moon Du You entered the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 以淮南行軍司馬王鍔檢校尚書右僕射，兼揚州大都督府長史、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: Huainan campaign marshal Wang E was made acting Minister of the Right, concurrent chief administrator of the great metropolitan prefecture of Yangzhou, and Huainan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang E succeeded Du You at Huainan.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以今年孟夏禘饗，前議太祖、懿、獻之位未決，至此禘祭，方正太祖東向之位，已下列序昭穆。

translations.literal: On dingmao because this year's midsummer di sacrifice was held, the prior debate on the positions of the Grand Ancestor, Yi, and Xian had not been settled; now at the di rite the Grand Ancestor's east-facing place was fixed, and below him the zhao-mu sequence was set.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the ancestral di rite finally fixed the Grand Ancestor's seat and the zhao-mu order.

sentences.zh: 其獻祖、懿祖祔於德明、興聖之廟，每禘祫年就本室饗之。

translations.literal: The Offering Ancestor and Resplendent Ancestor were enshrined in the Deming and Xingsheng temples; each di and xia year they were feasted in their own halls.
translations.idiomatic: Offering and Resplendent ancestors were housed in side temples and honored at the seasonal rites.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以司農卿李實為京兆尹。

translations.literal: On yihai Minister of Imperial Granaries Li Shi was made Capital Metropolitan Prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Li Shi became metropolitan prefect.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，涇原節度使劉昌奏請移行原州於平涼城，從之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, yiwei: Jingyuan military commissioner Liu Chang memorialized moving former Yuan Prefecture to Pingliang city — granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Liu Chang's move of Yuanzhou to Pingliang was approved.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，百官以祔廟畢，蹈舞稱賀。

translations.literal: On wuxu because enshrinement in the temple was complete, the hundred officials danced in congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu officials danced to celebrate the completed temple rites.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，荊南節度使、檢校工部尚書、江陵尹裴胄卒。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinhai: Jingnan military commissioner, acting Minister of Works, Jiangling prefect Pei Zhou died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Pei Zhou of Jingnan died.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以荊南行軍司馬裴筠為江陵尹、兼御史大夫、荊南節度使。

translations.literal: On yiwei Jingnan campaign marshal Pei Yun was made Jiangling prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Jingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Pei Yun became Jingnan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲子，四鎮北庭行軍涇原節度使、檢校右僕射、涇州刺史劉昌卒。

translations.literal: On jiazi Four Garrisons, Beiting campaign, Jingyuan military commissioner, acting Minister of the Right, Jing prefect Liu Chang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Liu Chang of Jingyuan died.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以涇原節度留後段祐為涇州刺史、兼御史大夫、四鎮北庭行軍涇原節度使。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Jingyuan acting chief Duan You was made Jing prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Four Garrisons–Beiting campaign Jingyuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Duan You succeeded Liu Chang at Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，吐蕃遣使論頻熱入朝。

translations.literal: On yihai Tibet sent the envoy Lun Pinre to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai a Tibetan envoy came to court.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以陳許行軍司馬劉昌裔檢校工部尚書，兼許州刺史、陳許節度使。

translations.literal: On jiachen Chen-Xu campaign marshal Liu Changyi was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Xuzhou prefect and Chen-Xu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Liu Changyi became Chen-Xu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 自正月至是未雨，分命祈禱山川。

translations.literal: From the first month until now no rain had fallen; orders were separately sent to pray at mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Since spring drought, prayers were sent to mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，以關輔，罷吏部選、禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuwu: because of the Guanzhong region, Personnel selection and Ministry of Rites examinations were stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month drought around the capital halted examinations.

sentences.zh: 己未，中書侍郎、平章事齊抗為太子賓客，病免也。

translations.literal: On jiwei Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Qi Kang was made heir-apparent guest — illness relieved him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Qi Kang left the chancellery for illness.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，雨。

translations.literal: On jiaxu rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu rain came.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，尚書右僕射姚南仲薨。

translations.literal: On yihai Minister of the Right Yao Nanzhong died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Yao Nanzhong died.

sentences.zh: 貸京畿民麥種。

translations.literal: Wheat seed was lent to the people of the capital districts.
translations.idiomatic: The capital districts received wheat seed on loan.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，大雨霖。

translations.literal: Eighth month, yiwei: long rains poured.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month rains lingered.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，以太子賓客韋夏卿為東都留守、東都畿汝都防禦使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, yiwei: heir-apparent guest Wei Xiaqing was made Luoyang protector and eastern capital Ji-Ru defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Wei Xiaqing became Luoyang protector.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁巳，門下侍郎、同平章事崔損卒。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, dingsi: Secretariat Vice Director and Concurrent Associate Cui Sun died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Cui Sun died.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅朔，以鹽州兵馬使李興幹為鹽州刺史，許專達於上，不隸夏州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuyin new moon: Yanzhou army marshal Li Xinggan was made Yan prefect, permitted direct memorial to the throne, not subordinate to Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh month's new moon Li Xinggan became Yanzhou prefect with direct access to the throne.

sentences.zh: 丙午，振、武、麟、勝節度使範希朝來朝。

translations.literal: On bingwu Zhen-Wu, Lin, and Sheng military commissioner Fan Xichao came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Fan Xichao of the northern frontier came to audience.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以振武行軍司馬閻巨源檢校工部尚書，兼單于大都護、振武麟勝節度使。

translations.literal: On wuwu Zhenwu campaign marshal Yan Juyuan was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Chanyu great protector, and Zhenwu-Lin-Sheng military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Yan Juyuan became Zhenwu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以太常卿高郢為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On gengshen Minister of Rites Gao Ying was made Secretariat Vice Director and Concurrent Associate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Gao Ying entered the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 壬申，監察御史崔薳入臺近，不練故事，違式入右神策軍。

translations.literal: On renshen Supervising Censor Cui Yuan had recently entered the censorate, was not versed in precedent, and improperly entered the Right Divine Strategy Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Cui Yuan, new to the censorate, trespassed into the Right Divine Strategy barracks.

sentences.zh: 上怒，笞四十，配流崖州。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry, flogged him forty strokes, and exiled him to Yazhou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had him beaten and sent to Yazhou.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月丁丑朔。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, spring, first month, dingchou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The twentieth year opened on dingchou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，天德軍防禦團練使、豐州刺史李景略卒，以其判官任迪簡代領其任。

translations.literal: On bingshen Tiande Army defense and training commissioner, Fengzhou prefect Li Jinglüe died; his legal clerk Ren Dijian was ordered to act in his place.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Li Jinglüe died; Ren Dijian succeeded him at Fengzhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以鄜、坊、丹、延節度使劉公濟為工部尚書，以其行軍司馬裴玢代領其任。

translations.literal: On jihai Yan-Fang-Dan-Yan military commissioner Liu Gongji was made Minister of Works; his campaign marshal Pei Fen was ordered to act in his place.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Liu Gongji became minister of works; Pei Fen took his command.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午朔，罷中和節宴，歲儉也。

translations.literal: Second month, bingwu new moon: the Central Harmony festival banquet was stopped — the year was lean.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Harmony feast was canceled for scarcity.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大雷震，雨雹。

translations.literal: On gengxu great thunder sounded and hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu thunder brought hail.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，以吐蕃贊普卒，廢朝。

translations.literal: Third month, jiashen: because the Tibetan qaghan died, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month court was canceled for the Tibetan qaghan's death.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以國子祭酒趙昌為安南都護、御史大夫、本管經略使。

translations.literal: On jihai National University director Zhao Chang was made Annan protector, censor-in-chief, and circuit pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Zhao Chang was sent to Annan as protector.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉，太子賓客齊抗卒。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinyou: heir-apparent guest Qi Kang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Qi Kang died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，吐蕃使臧河南觀察使論乞冉等五十四人來朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingyin Tibetan envoys including Zang Henan observation commissioner Lun Qiran, fifty-four persons, came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin fifty-four Tibetan envoys presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 陳許節度賜號忠武軍。

translations.literal: The Chen-Xu command was granted the name Zhongwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Chen-Xu was renamed the Zhongwu Army.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌朔，罷御宣政殿。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiaxu new moon: holding court at Xuanzheng Hall was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Court at Xuanzheng was suspended on the fifth month's new moon.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以史館修撰、秘書監張薦為工部侍郎、兼御史大夫，充入吐蕃吊祭使。

translations.literal: On yihai Historiography compiler and Palace Library director Zhang Jiang was made Works vice minister, concurrent censor-in-chief, and envoy to mourn the Tibetan qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zhang Jiang was sent to Tibet on condolence mission.

sentences.zh: 七月癸酉朔，大雨雹。

translations.literal: Seventh month, guiyou new moon: great hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh month's new moon hail fell heavily.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，福建觀察使柳冕奏置萬安監牧於泉州界，置群牧五，悉索部內馬牛羊近萬頭匹，監史主之。

translations.literal: On xinmao Fujian observation commissioner Liu Mian memorialized establishing the Wan'an supervisory pasture within Quanzhou's border, setting up five herd offices, gathering nearly ten thousand head of horses, cattle, and sheep from within the circuit — overseen by supervisory clerks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Fujian seized local livestock for a new Wan'an pasture.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，以房州刺史卻士美為黔中觀察使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wushen: Fangzhou prefect Que Shimei was made Qianzhong observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Que Shimei became Qianzhong observer.

sentences.zh: 己未，以昭義兵馬使盧從史為檢校工部尚書，兼潞州長史、昭義軍節度、澤潞磁邢洺觀察使。

translations.literal: On jiwei Zhaoyi army marshal Lu Congshi was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent chief administrator of Luzhou, Zhaoyi military commissioner, and Ze-Lu-Ci-Xing-Ming observer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Lu Congshi took Zhaoyi at Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰，賜群臣宴於馬璘山池。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengchen: ministers were feasted at Ma Lin's mountain pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the court feasted at Ma Lin's pool.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，於景州南皮縣置唐昌軍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiachen: the Tangchang Army was established at Nanpi County in Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Tangchang Army was founded at Nanpi.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，易定節度使張茂昭來朝。

translations.literal: On xinhai Yiding military commissioner Zhang Maozhao came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Zhang Maozhao of Yiding came to audience.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，以監察御史李程、秘書正字張聿、藍田縣尉王涯並為翰林學士。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingyou: supervising censors Li Cheng, Secretariat regular scribe Zhang Yu, and Lantian county lieutenant Wang Ya were all made Hanlin academicians.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Li Cheng, Zhang Yu, and Wang Ya entered the Hanlin.

sentences.zh: 十二月，吐蕃、南詔、日本國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Tibet, Nanzhao, and Japan all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Tibet, Nanzhao, and Japan sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以桂管防禦使顏證為桂州刺史、桂管觀察使。

translations.literal: On gengwu Gui defense commissioner Yan Zheng was made Guizhou prefect and Gui observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Yan Zheng became Gui commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月辛未朔，御含元殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, spring, first month, xinwei new moon: he attended Hanyuan Hall to receive court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-first year opened with New Year rites at Hanyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 是日，上不康。

translations.literal: That day the emperor was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor was ill.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以浙東觀察判官凌準為翰林學士，癸巳，會郡臣於宣政殿，宣遺詔：皇太子宜於柩前即位。

translations.literal: On bingzi Zhedong observation judge Ling Zhun was made Hanlin academician; on guisi he assembled the commandery ministers at Xuanzheng Hall and proclaimed the testamentary edict: the crown prince should succeed before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Ling Zhun entered the Hanlin; on guisi the death edict named the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 是日，上崩於會寧殿，享壽六十四。

translations.literal: That day the emperor died at Huining Hall, age sixty-four.
translations.idiomatic: That day Dezong died at Huining Hall, aged sixty-four.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遷神柩於太極殿。

translations.literal: On jiawu the spirit coffin was moved to Taiji Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the coffin was moved to Taiji Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙申，發喪，群臣縞素。

translations.literal: On bingshen mourning began; the ministers wore white hemp.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen mourning began in white.

sentences.zh: 皇太子即位。

translations.literal: The crown prince succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 永貞元年九月丁卯，群臣上謚曰神武孝文，廟號德宗。

translations.literal: Yongzhen first year, ninth month, dingmao: the ministers submitted the posthumous title Divine Martial Filial Literary and temple name Dezong.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzhen 9 the court gave the posthumous title Shenwu Xiaowen and temple name Dezong.

sentences.zh: 十月己酉，葬於崇陵，昭德皇后王氏祔焉。

translations.literal: Tenth month, jiyou: burial at Chongling; Empress Zhaode of the Wang clan was enshrined with him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he was buried at Chongling with Empress Zhaode.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：德宗皇帝初總萬機，勵精治道。

translations.literal: 【Historian's appraisal】 The historian says: When Emperor Dezong first took the reins of government, he strove to refine the way of rule.
translations.idiomatic: 【Historian's appraisal】 The historian writes: At first Dezong seized the throne and labored to govern well.

sentences.zh: 思政若渴，視民如傷。

translations.literal: He thirsted for sound policy as for water, and looked on the people as on a wound.
translations.idiomatic: He hungered for good counsel and grieved for the people as for an open sore.

sentences.zh: 凝旒延納於讜言，側席思求於多士。

translations.literal: With lowered tassels he prolonged reception of forthright words; with side seat he longed to seek many worthies.
translations.idiomatic: He listened for honest speech and searched the realm for talent.

sentences.zh: 其始也，去無名之費，罷不急之官；

translations.literal: At the beginning he removed nameless expenses and abolished non-urgent offices;
translations.idiomatic: Early on he cut waste posts and pointless spending;

sentences.zh: 出永巷之嬪嬙，放文單之馴象；

translations.literal: sent out the consorts of the Eternal Lane, released the tame elephants of Wendan;
translations.idiomatic: sent palace women from the rear quarters away, freed the court elephants;

sentences.zh: 減太官之膳，誡服玩之奢；

translations.literal: reduced the Grand Steward's meals, admonished luxury in dress and playthings;
translations.idiomatic: trimmed the imperial kitchen, and warned against finery and toys;

sentences.zh: 解鷹犬而放伶倫，止榷酤而絕貢奉。

translations.literal: freed hawks and dogs and released musicians, stopped monopoly on wine and cut off tribute offerings.
translations.idiomatic: gave up hunting birds and hounds, dismissed idle musicians, ended the wine monopoly, and stopped lavish tribute.

sentences.zh: 百神咸秩，五典克從，御正殿而策賢良，輟廷臣而治畿甸。

translations.literal: The hundred spirits were all in order, the five classics were all followed; he faced the main hall to examine the worthy and able, and set aside court ministers to govern the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Rites were restored, the classics honored; he held court examinations for talent and sent ministers to govern the capital districts.

sentences.zh: 此皆前王之能事，有國之大猷，率是而行，夫何敢議。

translations.literal: These were all deeds former kings could perform, great principles for a state — to follow them in full, who would dare find fault?
translations.idiomatic: These were the acts of sage kings and the foundations of empire; had he kept to them, who could object?

sentences.zh: 加以天才秀茂，文思雕華。

translations.literal: Moreover his heaven-given talent was splendid and flourishing, his literary thought carved and ornate.
translations.idiomatic: His gifts were bright and his prose polished.

sentences.zh: 灑翰金鑾，無愧淮南之作；

translations.literal: Brushing composition at the Golden Gate, he did not shame the Huainan master's works;
translations.idiomatic: At court he wrote verses worthy of the Huainan prince;

sentences.zh: 屬辭鉛槧，何慚隴坻之書。

translations.literal: joining phrases on lead tablets, how would he shrink from the Longdi book?
translations.idiomatic: and on bamboo and silk he matched the classics of the Longdi.

sentences.zh: 文雅中興，夐高前代，《二南》三祖，豈盛於茲。

translations.literal: Literary elegance revived — far above the previous age; could the "Two Souths" and three ancestral hymns surpass this?
translations.idiomatic: Letters flourished again, loftier than in recent reigns — a revival to rival the Odes themselves.

sentences.zh: 然而王霸跡殊，淳醨代變，揆時而理，斟酌斯難。

translations.literal: Yet the traces of kingship and hegemony differ, pure and coarse change with the age — to measure the time and govern is hard to weigh.
translations.idiomatic: Yet times differ: what makes a true king in one age fails in another, and to judge the moment is hardest of all.

sentences.zh: 茍於交喪之秋，輕取鄙夫之論，歷觀近世，靡不敗亡。

translations.literal: If in the season of mutual loss one lightly takes the counsel of base men, looking through recent times none have not been ruined.
translations.idiomatic: When the realm was already fraying, he still heeded petty advisers — and in our own age such rulers always fall.

sentences.zh: 德宗在籓齒胄之年，曾為統帥；

translations.literal: Dezong in his fief, in the years of capped youth, had once been commander-in-chief;
translations.idiomatic: As heir in his princedom he had already commanded armies;

sentences.zh: 及出震承乾之日，頗負經綸。

translations.literal: when he emerged to receive Heaven's mandate on the day of bearing the tripod, he bore considerable statecraft.
translations.idiomatic: and when he ascended the throne he seemed to carry real statecraft in him.

sentences.zh: 故從初罷郭令戎權，非次聽楊炎謬計，遂欲混同華裔，束縛奸豪，南行襄漢之誅，北舉恆陽之代。

translations.literal: Thus from the first, when he removed Guo Ziyi's military power and out of turn heeded Yang Yan's mistaken plan, he wished to unify Chinese and barbarian, bind the treacherous and strong, execute punishment south on Xiang and Han, and raise arms north against Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from the start he stripped Guo Ziyi of command and rashly followed Yang Yan — dreaming of binding every warlord at once, punishing the south and marching on the north.

sentences.zh: 出車雲擾，命將星繁，罄國用不足以餽軍，竭民力未聞於破賊。

translations.literal: Chariots went forth like clouds, appointed generals like stars — exhausting the state treasury yet not enough to feed the armies, draining the people's strength yet never hearing of breaking the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Armies rolled out in clouds of banners, generals were named by the score — the treasury emptied without feeding the hosts, the people were drained without breaking the enemy.

sentences.zh: 一旦德音掃地，愁嘆連甍，果致五盜僭擬於天王，二硃憑陵於宗社，奉天之窘，可為涕零，罪已之言，補之何益。

translations.literal: Once virtuous edicts were swept to the ground, lamentation linked roof to roof — it truly brought five bandits to usurp the Son of Heaven, and the two Zhu clans to press the altars of state; the distress at Fengtian could draw tears, and words of self-reproach — what did they repair?
translations.idiomatic: Then his good decrees vanished, grief filled every lane — five rebels mocked the throne, the Zhu kindred seized the altars, Fengtian became a siege that still brings tears, and even his confession could not undo the harm.

sentences.zh: 所賴忠臣戮力，否運再昌。

translations.literal: What was relied on was loyal ministers exerting strength together, and adverse fortune turning bright again.
translations.idiomatic: Only loyal ministers fighting together turned fortune back.

sentences.zh: 雖知非竟逐於楊炎，而受佞不忘於盧杞。

translations.literal: Although knowing his error he finally drove out Yang Yan, yet cherishing flatterers he did not forget Lu Qi.
translations.idiomatic: He did exile Yang Yan when he saw the fault, yet clung to Lu Qi and other flatterers.

sentences.zh: 用延賞之私怨，奪李晟之兵符；

translations.literal: Using Yan Shang's private grudge, he took Li Sheng's tally of command;
translations.idiomatic: He let Yan Shang's spite strip Li Sheng of command;

sentences.zh: 取延齡之奸謀。

translations.literal: he took Pei Yanling's treacherous schemes.
translations.idiomatic: he embraced Pei Yanling's plots;

sentences.zh: 罷陸贄之相位，知人則哲，其若是乎！

translations.literal: he removed Lu Zhi from the chancellorship — "knowing men then is wise" — is it like this!
translations.idiomatic: and drove Lu Zhi from office — is this what they mean by knowing men?

sentences.zh: 貞元之辰，吾道窮矣。

translations.literal: In the Zhenyuan years, our Way was at an end.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhenyuan the moral order was spent.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：聰明文思，惟睿作聖。

translations.literal: 【Eulogy】 Sagacious and bright, cultured and thoughtful — only the wise become sage.
translations.idiomatic: 【Eulogy】 Bright and literate, fit for sagehood —

sentences.zh: 保奸傷善，聽斷不令。

translations.literal: Protecting the wicked and harming the good, hearing and deciding without order.
translations.idiomatic: yet he shielded villains, wounded the good, and judged without justice.

sentences.zh: 御歷三九，適逢天幸。

translations.literal: He held the throne for thirty-nine years, and by chance met Heaven's favor.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-nine years on the throne owed more to luck than to rule;

sentences.zh: 賜宴之辰，徒矜篇詠。

translations.literal: On the days of granted feasts, he merely prided himself on verses.
translations.idiomatic: at his banquets he preened over poems alone.
